name: Caterpie

name: Diglett

name: Doduo

effect: Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Clefairy Doll counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). name: Computer Search
effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Devolution Spray
effect: Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. That Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or anything else that might be the result of an attack (just as if you had evolved it).

name: Impostor Professor Oak
effect: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

name: Item Finder
effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Lass
effect: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

name: Pokémon Breeder
effect: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

name: Pokémon Trader
effect: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Scoop Up
effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

name: Super Energy Removal
effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

name: Defender
effect: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Energy Retrieval
effect: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

name: Full Heal
effect: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

name: Maintenance
effect: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

name: PlusPower
effect: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

name: Pokémon Center
effect: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

name: Pokémon Flute
effect: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto his or her Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)

name: Pokédex
effect: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

name: Professor Oak
effect: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

name: Revive
effect: Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)

name: Super Potion
effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

name: Bill
effect: Draw 2 cards.

name: Energy Removal
effect: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

name: Gust of Wind
effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

name: Potion
effect: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Switch
effect: Switch 1 of your own Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

effect:
Provides {C}{C} energy.

name: Weezing

name: Ekans

name: Geodude

name: Grimer

name: Horsea

name: Kabuto

name: Krabby

name: Omanyte

name: Zubat

name: Alakazam

name: Blastoise

name: Chansey
flavor_text: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

name: Gyarados

name: Hitmonchan

name: Magneton

name: Mewtwo

name: Nidoking

name: Nidoqueen

name: Ninetales

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Poliwrath

name: Raichu

name: Scyther
flavor_text: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

name: Wigglytuff

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

name: Beedrill

name: Pidgeotto

name: Pinsir

name: Snorlax

name: Venomoth

name: Victreebel

name: Arcanine

name: Dratini

name: Exeggutor

name: Farfetch'd

name: Fearow

name: Growlithe

name: Nidorina

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Persian

name: Poliwhirl

name: Raticate
flavor_text: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

name: Rhydon

name: Seaking

name: Seel

name: Tauros
flavor_text: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Wartortle

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

name: Abra
flavor_text: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Cubone

name: Diglett

name: Doduo
flavor_text: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

name: Exeggcute

name: Gastly

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Nidoran♀
flavor_text: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidoran♂
flavor_text: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Onix
flavor_text: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

name: Paras
flavor_text: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pikachu

flavor_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

name: Staryu
evolves_to: Mega Starmie ex|Misty's Starmie|Starmie|Starmie GX|Starmie δ
flavor_text: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

name: Computer Search
effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Impostor Professor Oak
effect: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

name: Item Finder
effect: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Lass
effect: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

name: Pokémon Breeder
effect: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

name: Pokémon Trader

name: Scoop Up

name: Super Energy Removal

name: Energy Retrieval

name: Full Heal

name: Maintenance
effect: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

name: PlusPower

name: Pokémon Center
effect: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

name: Pokédex
effect: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

name: Professor Oak
effect: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

name: Super Potion
effect: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

name: Bill
effect: Draw 2 cards.

name: Energy Removal
effect: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

name: Gust of Wind
effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

name: Poké Ball
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for any Basic Pokémon or Evolution card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Potion
effect: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Switch
effect: Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

name: Double Colorless Energy
effect: Provides {C}{C} energy. Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.

name: Dark Alakazam

name: Dark Arbok

name: Dark Blastoise
flavor_text: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

name: Dark Charizard
flavor_text: Seemingly possessed, it spews fire like a volcano, trying to burn all it sees.

name: Dark Dragonite

name: Dark Dugtrio

name: Dark Golbat
flavor_text: Sneaks up silently on its prey and attacks it from behind, sometimes killing it with one bite.

name: Dark Gyarados
flavor_text: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

name: Dark Hypno
flavor_text: Carries a pendulum with it always. Sometimes appears near less-traveled roads and schools at dusk.

name: Dark Machamp

name: Natu

name: Wooper
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It leaves the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Arcade Game
effect: Shuffle your deck, then reveal the top 3 cards of it. If at least 2 of those cards share the same name, put all the ones with that name into your hand and shuffle the rest into your deck. If none of them do, shuffle all 3 into your deck.

name: Ecogym
effect: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Whenever an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card discards another player's non-Colorless Energy card from a Pokémon, return that Energy card to its owner's hand. (Energy cards that are discarded when that Pokémon is Knocked Out don't count.)

name: Energy Charge
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle up to 2 Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

name: Focus Band
effect: Attach Focus Band to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If the Pokémon Focus Band is attached to would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, that Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. Then, discard Focus Band.

name: Mary
effect: Draw 2 cards. Then, shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck.

name: PokéGear
effect: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. If any of them are Trainer cards, you may show 1 of them to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

name: Super Energy Retrieval
effect: Trade 2 of the other cards in your hand for 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile. If you have fewer than 4 basic Energy cards there, take all of them.

name: Time Capsule
effect: Your opponent may choose 5 Basic Pokémon, Evolution, and/or basic Energy cards in his or her discard pile. (If your opponent doesn't have that many, he or she chooses all or none of them.) If your opponent chooses any cards, he or she shuffles them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same, and you can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

name: Bill's Teleporter
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, draw 4 cards.

name: Card-Flip Game
effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's face-down Prizes. Guess whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card face up (and leave it face up). If you guessed right, draw 2 cards.

name: Gold Berry
effect: Attach Gold Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. At any time between turns, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokémon Gold Berry is attached to, you may remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokémon Gold Berry is attached to, remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry.

name: Miracle Berry
effect: Attach Miracle Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. At any time between turns, if the Pokémon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, you may remove all those effects from that Pokémon and discard Miracle Berry. At the start of each turn, if the Pokémon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, remove all of those effects from that Pokémon and discard Miracle Berry.

name: New Pokédex
effect: Shuffle your deck. Then, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

name: Professor Elm
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

name: Sprout Tower
effect: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. All damage done by Colorless Pokémon's attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Super Scoop Up
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

name: Berry
effect: Attach Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. At any time between turns, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokémon Berry is attached to, you may remove 2 of them and discard Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokémon Berry is attached to, remove 2 of them and discard Berry.

name: Double Gust
effect: If you have any Benched Pokémon, your opponent chooses 1 of them and switches it with your Active Pokémon. Then, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

name: Moo-Moo Milk
effect: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Flip 2 coins. Remove 2 damage counters times the number of heads from that Pokémon. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

name: Pokémon March
effect: Your opponent may search his or her deck for 1 Basic Pokémon card and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, you may search your deck for 1 Basic Pokémon card and put it onto your Bench. Then, each player shuffles his or her deck. (A player can't do any of this if his or her Bench is full.)

name: Super Rod
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, put an Evolution card from your discard pile, if any, into your hand. If tails, put a Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile, if any, into your hand.

name: Darkness Energy
effect:
If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon. At the end of every turn, put 1 damage counter on the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to, unless it's Darkness or has Dark in its name.
Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Recycle Energy
effect: Recycle Energy provides Colorless Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.) If this card is put into your discard pile from play, return it to your hand.

name: Stantler

name: Counterattack Claws

name: Team Rocket's Evil Deeds

name: Shining Celebi

name: Shining Charizard

name: Shining Kabutops
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

flavor_text: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

name: Articuno

name: Charizard

name: Dark Blastoise

name: Dark Dragonite

name: Flareon

name: Gyarados

name: Zapdos

name: Beedrill

name: Exeggutor

name: Golem

name: Hypno

name: Jynx

name: Kabutops
flavor_text: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Magneton

name: Mewtwo

name: Moltres

name: Nidoking

name: Nidoqueen

name: Pidgeot

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Arcanine

name: Eelektross

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Victini
flavor_text: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

name: Yamask
flavor_text: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Yamask
flavor_text: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

name: Solosis
flavor_text: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion
flavor_text: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel it burns.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Gigalith
flavor_text: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

name: Timburr
flavor_text: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
flavor_text: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor_text: It it thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor_text: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

name: Archen
flavor_text: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
flavor_text: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a volt of electricity.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attack. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: It wield the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arms attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Golett
flavor_text: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Landorus
flavor_text: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Deino
flavor_text: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

name: Durant
flavor_text: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves against Heatmor.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Audino
flavor_text: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Axew
flavor_text: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

name: Haxorus
flavor_text: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Seedot

name: Amoonguss

flavor_text: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

name: Frillish

name: Jellicent

name: Zebstrika

name: Emolga
flavor_text: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

name: Muk
flavor_text: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Musharna

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: They has mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: It immediately headbutts anyones that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Persian
flavor_text: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Accelgor

name: Flareon

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Slowbro

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

name: Prinplup
flavor_text: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Empoleon
flavor_text: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

name: Glaceon

name: Tympole

name: Slowking

name: Timburr

name: Gurdurr

flavor_text: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

flavor_text: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

flavor_text: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

name: Numel

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Victini
flavor_text: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

name: Tepig
flavor_text: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Pignite
flavor_text: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

name: Emboar
flavor_text: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 F.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Psyduck

flavor_text: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Delibird
flavor_text: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.

name: Oshawott
flavor_text: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavor_text: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Samurott
flavor_text: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Frillish
flavor_text: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

name: Spoink
flavor_text: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

name: Grumpig
flavor_text: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

name: Munna
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavor_text: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Woobat
flavor_text: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

name: Venipede
flavor_text: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state.

name: Whirlipede
flavor_text: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.

name: Scolipede
flavor_text: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Meloetta
flavor_text: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it's stunned with surprise.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Dwebble
flavor_text: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

name: Crustle

name: Mienfoo

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Vullaby
flavor_text: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

name: Mandibuzz
flavor_text: It makes a nest out of the bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

name: Scizor
flavor_text: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speed of over 180 mph.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Vibrava
evolves_to: Flygon|Flygon GX|Flygon ex|Flygon ex δ|Flygon δ
flavor_text: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavor_text: Known as "The Desert Spirit" this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Black Kyurem
flavor_text: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: White Kyurem
flavor_text: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Farfetch’d
flavor_text: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Taillow
flavor_text: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.

name: Spinda
flavor_text: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: By extending its rolled up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.

name: Lopunny
flavor_text: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Lillipup
flavor_text: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

name: Herdier
flavor_text: This very loyal Pokémon helps trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

name: Stoutland
flavor_text: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

name: Tranquill
flavor_text: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

name: Unfezant
flavor_text: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

name: Audino
flavor_text: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with telepathic power.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

name: Togetic
flavor_text: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind-hearted people.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

name: Whismur
flavor_text: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Loudred
flavor_text: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Exploud
flavor_text: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Extremely cautious, there is always one keeping watch, but they don't notice enemies coming from behind.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Bouffalant
flavor_text: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: It stands up to massive opponents, not out of courage, but out of recklessness. But that is how it gets stronger.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

name: Exeggcute
evolves_to: Alolan Exeggutor|Alolan Exeggutor GX|Alolan Exeggutor ex|Dark Exeggutor|Erika's Exeggutor|Exeggutor|Exeggutor δ|ナッシー[Exeggutor]
flavor_text: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

name: Treecko
flavor_text: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Grovyle
flavor_text: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Sceptile
flavor_text: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

name: Cacturne
flavor_text: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text: With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Seadra
evolves_to: Kingdra|Kingdra GX|Kingdra ex|Kingdra ex δ|Kingdra δ
flavor_text: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can't be seen when it melts away into water.

name: Wooper
flavor_text: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Quagsire
flavor_text: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Glaceon
flavor_text: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.

name: Vanillite
flavor_text: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

name: Vanillish
flavor_text: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148° F.

name: Kyurem
flavor_text: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

name: Nidoran♀
flavor_text: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from its barbs can be fatal.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino's.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

name: Nidoran♂
flavor_text: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
flavor_text: It's so stinky! Muk's body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

name: Espeon
flavor_text: Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather…and its foes' thoughts.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: Its cells are all magnetic, and it communicates with others by using magnetic pulses.

name: Metang
flavor_text: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

name: Yamask
flavor_text: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Yamask
flavor_text: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

name: Onix
flavor_text: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

name: Umbreon
flavor_text: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it's filled with a mysterious power.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.

name: Absol
flavor_text: It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

name: Deino

name: Deino

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Steelix
flavor_text: The iron it ingested with the soil it swallowed transformed its body and made it harder than diamonds.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

name: Dragonair
evolves_to: Dark Dragonite|Dragonite|Dragonite GX|Dragonite ex|Dragonite ex δ|Dragonite δ|Light Dragonite|Mega Dragonite ex
flavor_text: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

flavor_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: It is said that kids who drink Miltank's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

name: Kecleon
flavor_text: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

name: Starly
flavor_text: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Lileep
flavor_text: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

name: Cradily
flavor_text: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

name: Shelmet
flavor_text: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Accelgor
flavor_text: When its body dries out, it weakens. So it wraps a membrane around itself for protection while it spits poison.

name: Genesect
flavor_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

name: Glalie
flavor_text: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

name: Froslass
flavor_text: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Snover
flavor_text: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

name: Tirtouga
flavor_text: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta
flavor_text: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can't be a fixed destination.

name: Uxie
flavor_text: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.

name: Mesprit
flavor_text: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

name: Azelf
flavor_text: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

name: Munna
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavor_text: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

name: Solosis
flavor_text: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

name: Duosion
flavor_text: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

name: Golett
flavor_text: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

name: Throh
flavor_text: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

name: Sawk
flavor_text: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

name: Archen
flavor_text: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
flavor_text: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Aron
flavor_text: In order to build up its steel body, it eats iron ore. This pesky Pokémon is known to eat railroad tracks.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: Lairon fight over territory, and when their steel bodies collide, sparks fly.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Bagon
flavor_text: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Shelgon
evolves_to: Salamence|Salamence GX|Salamence ex|Salamence ex δ|Salamence δ
flavor_text: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Salamence

name: Bibarel

name: Poliwhirl

name: Poliwrath

name: Hypno
flavor_text: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavor_text: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Golett
flavor_text: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Machop
flavor_text: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: It wields the fur on its arm like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Landorus
flavor_text: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Tyrunt
flavor_text: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Tyrantrum
flavor_text: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

name: Drapion
flavor_text: It takes great pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

name: Sylveon
flavor_text: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Vibrava
evolves_to: Flygon|Flygon GX|Flygon ex|Flygon ex δ|Flygon δ
flavor_text: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavor_text: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

name: Noivern
flavor_text: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Tornadus
flavor_text: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
