name: Venonat
flavor_text: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Sewaddle
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
flavor_text: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavor_text: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Krabby
flavor_text: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
flavor_text: The large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
evolves_to: Dark Feraligatr|Feraligatr|Feraligatr ex|Feraligatr δ|Mega Feraligatr ex
flavor_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Finneon
flavor_text: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Lumineon
flavor_text: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

name: Frillish
flavor_text: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Alomomola
flavor_text: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Joltik
flavor_text: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from it mouth.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Gulpin
flavor_text: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach compromises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

name: Swalot
flavor_text: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

name: Munna
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavor_text: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavor_text: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
flavor_text: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Roggenrola
flavor_text: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Boldore
flavor_text: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
flavor_text: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another's stashes.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Heatran
flavor_text: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Diancie
flavor_text: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Deino
flavor_text: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: Their heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Goomy
flavor_text: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

name: Sliggoo
flavor_text: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

name: Goodra
flavor_text: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

name: Fearow
flavor_text: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land or rest.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its egg with injured people.

name: Blissey
flavor_text: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: While it sleeps, the head of its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.

name: Whismur
flavor_text: It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

name: Loudred
flavor_text: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then using its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

name: Exploud
flavor_text: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

name: Regigigas
flavor_text: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

flavor_text: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

name: Tangrowth
flavor_text: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Treecko
flavor_text: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Grovyle
flavor_text: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Sceptile
flavor_text: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

name: Sceptile

name: Lotad
flavor_text: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Lombre
flavor_text: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Ludicolo
flavor_text: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction–to and fro and sideways.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Volbeat
flavor_text: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

name: Illumise
flavor_text: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Magcargo

name: Torchic
flavor_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Torchic

name: Combusken
flavor_text: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Blaziken
flavor_text: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Seadra
evolves_to: Kingdra|Kingdra GX|Kingdra ex|Kingdra ex δ|Kingdra δ

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

name: Granbull
flavor_text: It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

name: Floette
flavor_text: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

name: Florges
flavor_text: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

name: Spritzee
flavor_text: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

name: Aromatisse
flavor_text: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Axew
flavor_text: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

name: Axew

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

name: Haxorus
flavor_text: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

name: Noivern
flavor_text: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It emerges out of the dark to attack.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Doduo

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It always stand on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

flavor_text: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Kricketot

name: Kricketune
flavor_text: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

name: Durant
flavor_text: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

name: Numel
flavor_text: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

name: Slowpoke
evolves_to: Dark Slowbro|Dark Slowking|Light Slowbro|Mega Slowbro ex|Sabrina's Slowbro|Slowbro|Slowking|Slowking ex
flavor_text: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

name: Slowking
flavor_text: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Shellder
flavor_text: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

name: Shellder

name: Cloyster

name: Staryu
evolves_to: Mega Starmie ex|Misty's Starmie|Starmie|Starmie GX|Starmie δ
flavor_text: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

name: Corsola
flavor_text: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Greninja
flavor_text: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: If you think that you had a good dream but you can't remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

name: Drapion
flavor_text: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Doublade
flavor_text: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: Apparently, it can detect innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: It flies at speeds equals to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 feet per second that can level houses.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Spritzee
flavor_text: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

name: Aromatisse
flavor_text: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

name: Dragalge
flavor_text: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

name: Stantler
flavor_text: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: Glameow
flavor_text: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

name: Purugly
flavor_text: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

name: Charmander

name: Metapod
flavor_text: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: No matter what happens, if we stick together, we can get past it. Forever and ever.

name: Paras
flavor_text: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: What a delicious-looking snowman! I think I'll sneak a bite. It's OK…no one's looking, right?

name: Tangela

name: Froslass
flavor_text: Spring is already here, so goodbye…

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: It swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: The plan for today is to do nothing. My awesome tail is all curled up, and my ears are tired, too.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Crackle…buzz…Dedenne…?! Beep…

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: When she's surrounded by cushions and dressers that I like, she looks just like a princess!

name: Gulpin
flavor_text: When Mom gets in the kitchen, the happiest things happen. I can feel my mouth watering!

name: Jirachi
flavor_text: The twinkle of the stars. The destiny of love. A miracle that grants wishes in the night sky.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: My number one. Exceptionally cute. A little princess.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: Intense silence. Two lamplights. Keep waiting for night to end.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: Hidden away in its jet-black wings is a red passion.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: It's OK. No one will take away your flower. You look cute even when you're angry.

name: Floette
flavor_text: The five of us team up to be the Pretty Young Girl Force! We'll show you some beautiful moves!

name: Shellder
flavor_text: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Swirlix

name: Cloyster

name: Slurpuff

name: Krabby

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: Wings and beaks. I like yours, and I like mine, too.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: This fluffiness makes everyone go crazy. Is it really that charming?

name: Articuno
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: Little friends, thanks for always helping me look so cute!

name: Yanma

name: Seedot

name: Nuzleaf

name: Shiftry

name: Foongus

name: Amoonguss

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: Its legs grow strong while it chases after its parent. It runs in fields and mountains all day.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Monferno
flavor_text: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Infernape
flavor_text: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Litleo

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

name: Volcanion
flavor_text: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Mantine
flavor_text: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

name: Shellos
flavor_text: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

name: Gastrodon
flavor_text: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

name: Oshawott

name: Dewott

name: Samurott
flavor_text: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Clauncher

name: Clawitzer

name: Bergmite

name: Avalugg

name: Mareep

name: Flaaffy

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Joltik

name: Galvantula

name: Nidoran♂

name: Nidorino

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Drifloon

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: It's drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

name: Litwick

name: Lampent

name: Chandelure

name: Primeape

flavor_text: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

name: Armaldo
flavor_text: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Shieldon
flavor_text: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

name: Bastiodon
flavor_text: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Klang
flavor_text: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn't return, it will die.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Deino
flavor_text: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Torchic
flavor_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Magikarp
evolves_to: Dark Gyarados|Giovanni's Gyarados|Gyarados|Gyarados GX|Gyarados ex|Gyarados δ|Misty's Gyarados
flavor_text: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Eevee
evolves_to: Dark Espeon|Dark Flareon|Dark Jolteon|Dark Vaporeon|Espeon|Espeon GX|Espeon ex|Espeon δ|Espeon-GX|Flareon|Flareon GX|Flareon ex|Flareon δ|Glaceon|Glaceon GX|Glaceon ex|Glaceon-GX|Jolteon|Jolteon GX|Jolteon ex|Jolteon δ|Leafeon|Leafeon GX|Leafeon ex|Leafeon-GX|Light Flareon|Light Jolteon|Light Vaporeon|Lt. Surge's Jolteon|Sylveon|Sylveon GX|Sylveon ex|Sylveon-GX|Umbreon|Umbreon GX|Umbreon ex|Umbreon δ|Umbreon-GX|Vaporeon|Vaporeon GX|Vaporeon ex|Vaporeon δ
flavor_text: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: This Pokémon is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Blue plant vines cloak the Pokémon's identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
evolves_to: Blaine's Charizard|Charizard|Charizard GX|Charizard ex|Charizard δ|Charizard-GX|Dark Charizard|Mega Charizard X ex|Mega Charizard Y ex|Special Delivery Charizard
flavor_text: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: A Pokémon that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

name: Seel
flavor_text: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

name: Staryu
evolves_to: Mega Starmie ex|Misty's Starmie|Starmie|Starmie GX|Starmie δ
flavor_text: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

name: Magikarp
evolves_to: Dark Gyarados|Giovanni's Gyarados|Gyarados|Gyarados GX|Gyarados ex|Gyarados δ|Misty's Gyarados
flavor_text: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to Screech or suddenly Self-Destruct.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

name: Nidoran♂
flavor_text: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It is easily angered. By swinging its well-developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

name: Haunter
evolves_to: Dark Gengar|Gengar|Gengar ex|Mega Gengar ex|Sabrina's Gengar
flavor_text: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: A descendant of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

name: Mew
flavor_text: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.

name: ナッシー[Exeggutor]
flavor_text: Dr.オーヤマ考案「日米交流カード」パーティ気分で和洋せっちゅう。

name: Flying Pikachu
flavor_text: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

name: Surfing Pikachu
flavor_text: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.

name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
effect: Each player turns all of his or her Prize cards face up. (Those Prize cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

name: Paras
flavor_text: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: Decidueye
flavor_text: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

name: Grubbin
flavor_text: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

name: Fomantis
flavor_text: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

name: Morelull
flavor_text: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

name: Shiinotic
flavor_text: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

name: Steenee
flavor_text: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

name: Tsareena
flavor_text: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

name: Litten
flavor_text: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Torracat
flavor_text: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: Incineroar
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

name: Shellder
flavor_text: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

name: Cloyster
flavor_text: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

name: Corsola
flavor_text: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

name: Wingull
flavor_text: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

name: Pelipper
flavor_text: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

name: Popplio
flavor_text: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Brionne
flavor_text: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

name: Primarina
flavor_text: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learning from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

name: Crabominable
flavor_text: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

name: Wishiwashi
flavor_text: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Pyukumuku
flavor_text: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

name: Bruxish
flavor_text: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Charjabug
flavor_text: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavor_text: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

name: Alolan Muk
flavor_text: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it's ever eaten.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

name: Mareanie
flavor_text: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: Toxapex
flavor_text: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Cosmoem
flavor_text: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

flavor_text: A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.

name: Deoxys
flavor_text: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Ultra Necrozma
flavor_text: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

name: Detective Pikachu
flavor_text: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Volcanion
flavor_text: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Stakataka
flavor_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

name: Detective Pikachu
flavor_text: He was the partner of Tim's father, Harry, who has gone missing. This Pikachu loves the dark coffee at the Hi-Hat Cafe.

name: Detective Pikachu
flavor_text: Skilled in deduction, he's a self-proclaimed "great detective." His detective hat is his trademark.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Amoonguss
flavor_text: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Tapu Fini
flavor_text: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Necrozma
flavor_text: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: It's so popular with the elderly that there's a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

name: Stakataka
flavor_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

name: Mew
flavor_text: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Buzzwole
flavor_text: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Entei
flavor_text: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Phione
flavor_text: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

name: Blacephalon
flavor_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

name: Terrakion

name: Celebi
flavor_text: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Victini
flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: This Pokémon was created by Mewtwo to prove that copies can be even more powerful than their originals.

flavor_text: Mewtwo was on a rampage searching for meaning to its existence in this world when Giovanni suppressed and controlled its power.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Golisopod
flavor_text: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

name: Victini
flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: Turtonator
flavor_text: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavor_text: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavor_text: Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy mountain. As it races through the snowfields, it sends up a spray of snow.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text: They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.

name: Politoed
flavor_text: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

name: Delibird
flavor_text: Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.

name: Glalie
flavor_text: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.

name: Vanillite
flavor_text: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

name: Vanillish
flavor_text: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.

name: Alomomola
flavor_text: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

name: Wishiwashi
flavor_text: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: Mareanie
flavor_text: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavor_text: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavor_text: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

name: Alolan Golem
flavor_text: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

name: Slowpoke
evolves_to: Dark Slowbro|Dark Slowking|Light Slowbro|Mega Slowbro ex|Sabrina's Slowbro|Slowbro|Slowking|Slowking ex
flavor_text: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder's poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavor_text: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by horror and died of the shock.

name: Dhelmise
flavor_text: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

name: Lunala
flavor_text: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: Machop
flavor_text: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

name: Machop
flavor_text: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

name: Barboach
flavor_text: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

name: Whiscash
flavor_text: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: Mudbray
flavor_text: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: Mudsdale
flavor_text: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Minior
flavor_text: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, "Get home before the Murkrow fly."

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It's a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Metang
flavor_text: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

name: Solgaleo
flavor_text: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: They don't like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

name: Comfey
flavor_text: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

name: Goomy
flavor_text: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it's unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.

name: Sliggoo
flavor_text: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.

name: Goodra
flavor_text: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it will completely destroy its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Jangmo-o
flavor_text: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: Hakamo-o
flavor_text: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

name: Blissey
flavor_text: Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm when they eat Blissey's egg, which is said to be filled with happiness.

name: Taillow
flavor_text: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Swellow
flavor_text: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Castform
flavor_text: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

name: Rayquaza
flavor_text: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.

name: Stufful
flavor_text: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Komala
flavor_text: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
