name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
evolves_to: Bellossom|Bellossom δ|Dark Vileplume|Erika's Vileplume|Vileplume|Vileplume GX|Vileplume ex|Vileplume δ
flavor_text: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Tangrowth
flavor_text: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

name: Ledyba
flavor_text: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

name: Ledian
flavor_text: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

name: Pansage
flavor_text: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Simisage
flavor_text: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmeleon
evolves_to: Blaine's Charizard|Charizard|Charizard GX|Charizard ex|Charizard δ|Charizard-GX|Dark Charizard|Mega Charizard X ex|Mega Charizard Y ex|Special Delivery Charizard
flavor_text: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Pansear
flavor_text: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

name: Simisear
flavor_text: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Turtonator
flavor_text: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavor_text: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Seadra
evolves_to: Kingdra|Kingdra GX|Kingdra ex|Kingdra ex δ|Kingdra δ
flavor_text: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

name: Magikarp
evolves_to: Dark Gyarados|Giovanni's Gyarados|Gyarados|Gyarados GX|Gyarados ex|Gyarados δ|Misty's Gyarados
flavor_text: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

name: Panpour
flavor_text: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

name: Simipour
flavor_text: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Bruxish
flavor_text: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: Slowking
flavor_text: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Seviper
flavor_text: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

name: Venipede
flavor_text: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Whirlipede
flavor_text: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

name: Scolipede
flavor_text: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: Palossand
flavor_text: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Rhyperior
flavor_text: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

name: Sawk
flavor_text: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

name: Crabrawler
flavor_text: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: Crabominable
flavor_text: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: Mudbray
flavor_text: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: Mudsdale
flavor_text: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Passimian
flavor_text: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavor_text: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavor_text: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavor_text: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Darkrai
flavor_text: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
evolves_to: Gallade|Gardevoir|Gardevoir GX|Gardevoir ex|Gardevoir ex δ|Gardevoir δ|Gardevoir-GX|Mega Gallade ex|Mega Gardevoir ex
flavor_text: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Diancie
flavor_text: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Cutiefly
flavor_text: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Ribombee
flavor_text: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: Morelull
flavor_text: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
flavor_text: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.

name: Persian
flavor_text: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

name: Porygon2
flavor_text: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor_text: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

name: Bouffalant
flavor_text: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Stufful
flavor_text: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

name: Venusaur
flavor_text: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Virizion
flavor_text: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Shining Genesect
flavor_text: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Litten
flavor_text: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Torracat
flavor_text: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: Incineroar
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
evolves_to: Dark Feraligatr|Feraligatr|Feraligatr ex|Feraligatr δ|Mega Feraligatr ex
flavor_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Qwilfish
flavor_text: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

name: Palkia
flavor_text: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Shining Volcanion
flavor_text: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Raikou
flavor_text: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Plusle
flavor_text: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Minun
flavor_text: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

name: Ekans
flavor_text: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
flavor_text: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Shining Mew
flavor_text: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Latios
flavor_text: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Shining Jirachi
flavor_text: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

name: Golett
flavor_text: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Marshadow
flavor_text: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Zorua
flavor_text: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

name: Shining Rayquaza
flavor_text: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Shining Arceus
flavor_text: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Exeggcute
evolves_to: Alolan Exeggutor|Alolan Exeggutor GX|Alolan Exeggutor ex|Dark Exeggutor|Erika's Exeggutor|Exeggutor|Exeggutor δ|ナッシー[Exeggutor]
flavor_text: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Cacturne
flavor_text: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Shelmet
flavor_text: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Accelgor
flavor_text: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Skiddo
flavor_text: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Gogoat
flavor_text: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavor_text: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

name: Numel
flavor_text: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Staryu
evolves_to: Mega Starmie ex|Misty's Starmie|Starmie|Starmie GX|Starmie δ
flavor_text: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

name: Magikarp
evolves_to: Dark Gyarados|Giovanni's Gyarados|Gyarados|Gyarados GX|Gyarados ex|Gyarados δ|Misty's Gyarados
flavor_text: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

name: Swinub
flavor_text: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
flavor_text: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

name: Mamoswine
flavor_text: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

name: Corphish
flavor_text: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt
flavor_text: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Regice
flavor_text: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

name: Shellos
flavor_text: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

name: Alolan Raichu
flavor_text: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavor_text: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavor_text: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

name: Haunter
evolves_to: Dark Gengar|Gengar|Gengar ex|Mega Gengar ex|Sabrina's Gengar
flavor_text: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

name: Spoink
flavor_text: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

name: Grumpig
flavor_text: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavor_text: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
flavor_text: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: Oranguru
flavor_text: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

name: Cubone
evolves_to: Alolan Marowak|Alolan Marowak GX|Dark Marowak|Marowak|Marowak δ
flavor_text: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

name: Regirock
flavor_text: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

name: Gastrodon
flavor_text: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

name: Stufful
flavor_text: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

name: Deino
flavor_text: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Aron
flavor_text: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

name: Registeel
flavor_text: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you'll become sleepy right away.

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Jangmo-o
flavor_text: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: Hakamo-o
flavor_text: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: Kommo-o
flavor_text: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank's.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

name: Regigigas
flavor_text: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Type: Null
flavor_text: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Roselia
flavor_text: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

name: Roserade
flavor_text: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Grotle
flavor_text: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Torterra
flavor_text: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

name: Cherrim
flavor_text: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Mow Rotom
flavor_text: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn't calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,500 degrees Fahrenheit. Its arm starts to melt when it fires a whole barrage.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Monferno
flavor_text: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Infernape
flavor_text: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Heat Rotom
flavor_text: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Turtonator
flavor_text: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavor_text: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavor_text: This Pokémon's steel spikes are sheathed in ice. Stabs from these spikes cause deep wounds and severe frostbite as well.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Prinplup
flavor_text: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

name: Empoleon
flavor_text: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

name: Snover
flavor_text: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Wash Rotom
flavor_text: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Frost Rotom
flavor_text: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: If for some reason its body bursts, its soul spills out with a screaming sound.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

name: Drapion
flavor_text: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Giratina ◇
flavor_text: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Cresselia
flavor_text: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Cosmoem
flavor_text: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

name: Lunala ◇
flavor_text: Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

name: Cranidos
flavor_text: In rock layers where Cranidos fossils are found, the fossilized trunks of trees snapped in two are also often found.

name: Rampardos
flavor_text: Records exist of a revived fossil that evolved into Rampardos. It proceeded to escape and then destroy a skyscraper with a headbutt.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

name: Passimian
flavor_text: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: Seen as a symbol of bad luck, it's generally disliked. Yet it gives presents—objects that sparkle or shine—to Trainers it's close to.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: If its Murkrow cronies fail to catch food for it, or if it feels they have betrayed it, it will hunt them down wherever they are and punish them.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They dwell in cold places. This Pokémon's main food source in Alola is Vulpix and Sandshrew, which they carefully divide among their group.

name: Stunky
flavor_text: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

name: Skuntank
flavor_text: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

name: Darkrai ◇
flavor_text: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavor_text: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavor_text: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Shieldon
flavor_text: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

name: Bastiodon
flavor_text: It lived in the same environments as Rampardos. Their fossils have been found together—seemingly from after they'd fought to the finish.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Heatran
flavor_text: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Solgaleo ◇
flavor_text: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

name: Magearna
flavor_text: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: Morelull
flavor_text: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
flavor_text: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: Tapu Lele
flavor_text: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavor_text: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.

flavor_text: Six of them together form a full-fledged Pokémon. It's often hunted by Crabrawler, but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavor_text: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Snover
flavor_text: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Scatterbug
flavor_text: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Scatterbug
flavor_text: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
flavor_text: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
flavor_text: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Skiddo
flavor_text: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
flavor_text: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Pheromosa
flavor_text: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavor_text: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

name: Heatran
flavor_text: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
flavor_text: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
flavor_text: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degree Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Clauncher
flavor_text: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

name: Clawitzer
flavor_text: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

name: Amaura
flavor_text: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

name: Aurorus
flavor_text: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.

name: Bergmite
flavor_text: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

name: Avalugg
flavor_text: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

name: Volcanion ◇
flavor_text: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

name: Xurkitree
flavor_text: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Uxie
flavor_text: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

name: Mesprit
flavor_text: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

name: Azelf
flavor_text: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Doublade
flavor_text: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

name: Dragalge
flavor_text: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Poipole
flavor_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Cubone
evolves_to: Alolan Marowak|Alolan Marowak GX|Dark Marowak|Marowak|Marowak δ
flavor_text: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

name: Torterra
flavor_text: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Infernape
flavor_text: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

name: Binacle
flavor_text: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

name: Barbaracle
flavor_text: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

name: Tyrunt
flavor_text: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

name: Tyrantrum
flavor_text: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

name: Diancie ◇
flavor_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

name: Buzzwole
flavor_text: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

name: Guzzlord
flavor_text: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

name: Empoleon
flavor_text: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

name: Floette
flavor_text: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

name: Florges
flavor_text: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

name: Sylveon
flavor_text: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

name: Goomy
flavor_text: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

name: Goomy

name: Sliggoo
flavor_text: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

name: Goodra
flavor_text: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

name: Arceus ◇
flavor_text: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Noivern
flavor_text: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.

name: Treecko
flavor_text: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Treecko
flavor_text: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Grovyle
flavor_text: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Sceptile
flavor_text: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

name: Seedot
flavor_text: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Seedot
flavor_text: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its head. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

name: Volbeat
flavor_text: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

name: Illumise
flavor_text: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
flavor_text: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Dhelmise
flavor_text: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Torchic

name: Lunatone

name: Minior

name: Sableye

name: Jirachi ◇

name: Kartana

name: Bagon

name: Treecko

name: Grovyle

name: Dustox

name: Nincada

name: Ninjask

name: Shaymin

name: Skiddo

name: Gogoat

name: Moltres

name: Typhlosion
flavor_text: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Slugma

name: Houndour
flavor_text: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Entei
flavor_text: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Heatran
flavor_text: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Victini
flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

name: Delibird
flavor_text: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

name: Suicune

name: Cubchoo
flavor_text: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

name: White Kyurem
flavor_text: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Brionne

name: Primarina

name: Mareanie

name: Toxapex

name: Bruxish
flavor_text: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Mareep

name: Pachirisu

name: Zebstrika

name: Stunfisk

name: Dedenne

name: Natu

name: Xatu

name: Espeon

name: Shedinja

name: Sableye
flavor_text: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

name: Giratina

name: Poipole

name: Naganadel

name: Onix

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It's a particular favorite among elderly people.

name: Phanpy

name: Donphan
flavor_text: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you'd like.

name: Larvitar

name: Scizor

flavor_text: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

name: Blissey
flavor_text: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

name: Kakuna

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Paras
flavor_text: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.

name: Shaymin ◇
flavor_text: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmander
