name: Charmeleon
evolves_to: Blaine's Charizard|Charizard|Charizard GX|Charizard ex|Charizard δ|Charizard-GX|Dark Charizard|Mega Charizard X ex|Mega Charizard Y ex|Special Delivery Charizard
flavor_text: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

name: Litten
flavor_text: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

name: Torracat
flavor_text: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

name: Staryu
evolves_to: Mega Starmie ex|Misty's Starmie|Starmie|Starmie GX|Starmie δ
flavor_text: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

name: Magikarp
evolves_to: Dark Gyarados|Giovanni's Gyarados|Gyarados|Gyarados GX|Gyarados ex|Gyarados δ|Misty's Gyarados
flavor_text: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."

name: Lapras
flavor_text: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavor_text: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavor_text: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavor_text: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."

name: Alolan Golem
flavor_text: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

name: Joltik
flavor_text: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

name: Tapu Koko ◇
flavor_text: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Nidoran♀
flavor_text: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

name: Nidoran♂
flavor_text: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.

name: Muk
flavor_text: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavor_text: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: Its sparkling core is called "the gem of the sea." This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

name: Cosmoem
flavor_text: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

name: Omanyte
flavor_text: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

name: Omastar
flavor_text: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

name: Kabuto
flavor_text: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

name: Kabutops
flavor_text: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
evolves_to: Dark Tyranitar|Tyranitar|Tyranitar GX|Tyranitar ex|Tyranitar ex δ|Tyranitar δ
flavor_text: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavor_text: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

name: Alolan Muk
flavor_text: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago

name: Zorua
flavor_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark
flavor_text: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Vullaby
flavor_text: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

name: Mandibuzz
flavor_text: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.

name: Jirachi
flavor_text: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Doublade
flavor_text: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavor_text: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavor_text: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavor_text: Exeggutor is the pride of the Alolan people. Its image is carved into historical buildings and murals.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgey

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

name: Farfetch’d
flavor_text: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Aerodactyl
flavor_text: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Zangoose
flavor_text: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

name: Detective Pikachu
flavor_text: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

name: Ditto
flavor_text: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
evolves_to: Bellossom|Bellossom δ|Dark Vileplume|Erika's Vileplume|Vileplume|Vileplume GX|Vileplume ex|Vileplume δ
flavor_text: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Tangrowth
flavor_text: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

name: Grubbin
flavor_text: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

name: Kartana
flavor_text: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

name: Volcanion
flavor_text: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Litten
flavor_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Litten
flavor_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavor_text: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

name: Incineroar
flavor_text: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

name: Blacephalon
flavor_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

name: Slowpoke
evolves_to: Dark Slowbro|Dark Slowking|Light Slowbro|Mega Slowbro ex|Sabrina's Slowbro|Slowbro|Slowking|Slowking ex
flavor_text: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.

name: Seel
flavor_text: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.

name: Krabby
flavor_text: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
flavor_text: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.

name: Kyurem
flavor_text: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Pyukumuku
flavor_text: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Charjabug
flavor_text: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Ekans
flavor_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok
flavor_text: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

name: Haunter
evolves_to: Dark Gengar|Gengar|Gengar ex|Mega Gengar ex|Sabrina's Gengar
flavor_text: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Weezing
flavor_text: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

name: Mew
flavor_text: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Marshadow
flavor_text: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem
flavor_text: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

name: Cubone
evolves_to: Alolan Marowak|Alolan Marowak GX|Dark Marowak|Marowak|Marowak δ
flavor_text: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Rhyperior
flavor_text: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Wooper
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavor_text: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Tyrogue
flavor_text: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

name: Landorus
flavor_text: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Crabrawler
flavor_text: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

name: Crabominable
flavor_text: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

name: Stakataka
flavor_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

name: Greninja
flavor_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavor_text: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavor_text: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

name: Aron
flavor_text: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

name: Genesect
flavor_text: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Cleffa
flavor_text: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavor_text: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

name: Spritzee
flavor_text: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Aromatisse
flavor_text: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

name: Fearow
flavor_text: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Meowth
flavor_text: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

name: Porygon2
flavor_text: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor_text: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

name: Glameow
flavor_text: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

name: Purugly
flavor_text: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

name: Happiny
flavor_text: Usually it's a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

name: Fire Crystal

name: Pokégear 3.0

name: Triple Acceleration Energy
effect:

This card provides ColorlessColorlessColorless Energy only while it is attached to an Evolution Pokémon.

If this card is attached to anything other than an Evolution Pokémon, discard this card.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Celebi
flavor_text: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Sewaddle
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Sewaddle
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
flavor_text: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavor_text: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Dwebble
flavor_text: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

name: Crustle
flavor_text: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Foongus
flavor_text: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Amoonguss
flavor_text: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Fomantis
flavor_text: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

name: Lurantis
flavor_text: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

name: Steenee
flavor_text: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

name: Tsareena
flavor_text: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

name: Dhelmise
flavor_text: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.

name: Numel
flavor_text: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Victini
flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

name: Froslass
flavor_text: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

name: Finneon
flavor_text: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

name: Lumineon
flavor_text: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

name: Snover
flavor_text: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

name: Basculin
flavor_text: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

name: Tirtouga
flavor_text: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

name: Carracosta
flavor_text: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

name: Golisopod
flavor_text: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

name: Pyukumuku
flavor_text: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

name: Tapu Fini
flavor_text: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Alolan Raichu
flavor_text: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is "hodad."

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.

name: Joltik
flavor_text: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Thundurus
flavor_text: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Tapu Koko
flavor_text: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Xurkitree
flavor_text: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Exeggcute
evolves_to: Alolan Exeggutor|Alolan Exeggutor GX|Alolan Exeggutor ex|Dark Exeggutor|Erika's Exeggutor|Exeggutor|Exeggutor δ|ナッシー[Exeggutor]
flavor_text: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavor_text: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

name: Wynaut
flavor_text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: There's a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you'll be carried away to the afterlife.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Uxie
flavor_text: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

name: Mesprit
flavor_text: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

name: Azelf
flavor_text: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

name: Giratina
flavor_text: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

name: Cresselia
flavor_text: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Munna
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavor_text: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Doublade
flavor_text: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Mareanie
flavor_text: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

name: Toxapex
flavor_text: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Necrozma
flavor_text: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

name: Poipole
flavor_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Onix
flavor_text: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Cubone
evolves_to: Alolan Marowak|Alolan Marowak GX|Dark Marowak|Marowak|Marowak δ
flavor_text: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Meditite
flavor_text: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

name: Medicham
flavor_text: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn't care too much.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Archen
flavor_text: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.

name: Archeops
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Meloetta
flavor_text: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavor_text: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.

name: Drapion
flavor_text: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

name: Dragonair
evolves_to: Dark Dragonite|Dragonite|Dragonite GX|Dragonite ex|Dragonite ex δ|Dragonite δ|Light Dragonite|Mega Dragonite ex
flavor_text: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

name: Dragonair
evolves_to: Dark Dragonite|Dragonite|Dragonite GX|Dragonite ex|Dragonite ex δ|Dragonite δ|Light Dragonite|Mega Dragonite ex
flavor_text: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

name: Latias
flavor_text: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Axew
flavor_text: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

name: Haxorus
flavor_text: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.

name: Noivern
flavor_text: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it "the emperor of dark nights."

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bibarel
flavor_text: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

name: Munchlax
flavor_text: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

name: Tranquill
flavor_text: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

name: Unfezant
flavor_text: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

name: Audino
flavor_text: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Tornadus
flavor_text: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: While it's an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.

name: Yungoos
flavor_text: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

name: Gumshoos
flavor_text: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.

name: Oranguru
flavor_text: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Type: Null
flavor_text: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Silvally
flavor_text: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Komala
flavor_text: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

name: Mew

name: Geodude
flavor_text: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem
flavor_text: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

name: Cubone

name: Clefable
flavor_text: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

name: Farfetch’d
flavor_text: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

name: Kangaskhan

name: Scyther
flavor_text: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Pheromosa
flavor_text: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
evolves_to: Blaine's Charizard|Charizard|Charizard GX|Charizard ex|Charizard δ|Charizard-GX|Dark Charizard|Mega Charizard X ex|Mega Charizard Y ex|Special Delivery Charizard
flavor_text: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Wooper
flavor_text: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

name: Quagsire
flavor_text: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Xurkitree
flavor_text: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

name: Seviper
flavor_text: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

name: Shuppet
flavor_text: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

name: Poipole
flavor_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

name: Buzzwole
flavor_text: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

name: Zorua
flavor_text: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

name: Guzzlord
flavor_text: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Metang
flavor_text: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

name: Celesteela
flavor_text: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

name: Kartana
flavor_text: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia

name: Diancie
flavor_text: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

name: Alolan Meowth
