name: Lileep
flavor_text: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.

name: Cradily
flavor_text: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

name: Kricketot
flavor_text: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

name: Kricketune
flavor_text: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

name: Deerling
flavor_text: Their coloring changes according to the season and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

name: Sawsbuck
flavor_text: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

name: Decidueye
flavor_text: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

name: Buzzwole
flavor_text: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

name: Slugma
flavor_text: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Entei
flavor_text: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

name: Victini
flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Tepig
flavor_text: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavor_text: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

name: Emboar
flavor_text: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text: If you carelessly approach it because it's cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

name: Glalie
flavor_text: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.

name: Spheal
flavor_text: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

name: Spheal
flavor_text: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

name: Sealeo
flavor_text: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

name: Walrein
flavor_text: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Kyogre
flavor_text: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

name: Prinplup
flavor_text: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

name: Empoleon
flavor_text: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

name: Phione
flavor_text: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Black Kyurem
flavor_text: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Wishiwashi
flavor_text: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn's bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Weezing
flavor_text: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Natu
flavor_text: Although it still can't fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: It's said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it's not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
evolves_to: Gallade|Gardevoir|Gardevoir GX|Gardevoir ex|Gardevoir ex δ|Gardevoir δ|Gardevoir-GX|Mega Gallade ex|Mega Gardevoir ex
flavor_text: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Gallade
flavor_text: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Woobat
flavor_text: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

name: Golett
flavor_text: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master's orders faithfully.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

name: Dragalge
flavor_text: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

name: Dhelmise
flavor_text: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Cosmoem
flavor_text: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.

name: Lunala
flavor_text: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."

name: Marshadow
flavor_text: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

name: Blacephalon
flavor_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Onix
flavor_text: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

name: Vibrava
evolves_to: Flygon|Flygon GX|Flygon ex|Flygon ex δ|Flygon δ
flavor_text: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

name: Anorith
flavor_text: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don't thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.

name: Armaldo
flavor_text: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.

name: Groudon
flavor_text: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Throh
flavor_text: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

name: Crabrawler
flavor_text: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

name: Crabominable
flavor_text: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

name: Passimian
flavor_text: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

name: Palossand
flavor_text: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavor_text: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavor_text: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Alolan Muk
flavor_text: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

name: Absol
flavor_text: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

name: Guzzlord
flavor_text: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavor_text: After fleeing a volcanic eruption, it ended up moving to an area of snowy mountains. Its ice shell is as hard as steel.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavor_text: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

name: Solgaleo
flavor_text: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavor_text: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain's base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

name: Azurill
flavor_text: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

name: Floette
flavor_text: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

name: Florges
flavor_text: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Sylveon
flavor_text: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.

name: Jangmo-o
flavor_text: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

name: Jangmo-o
flavor_text: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

name: Hakamo-o
flavor_text: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

name: Kommo-o
flavor_text: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

name: Ultra Necrozma
flavor_text: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

flavor_text: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

flavor_text: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

name: Igglybuff
flavor_text: It's always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it's asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!

name: Aipom
flavor_text: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

name: Zangoose
flavor_text: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

name: Lillipup
flavor_text: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can't defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.

name: Herdier
flavor_text: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.

name: Stoutland
flavor_text: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Stufful
flavor_text: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

name: Type: Null
flavor_text: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Beastite
effect: The attacks of the Ultra Beast this card is attached to do 10 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon for each Prize card you have taken (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Bellelba & Brycen-Man
effect:
Discard 3 cards from the top of each player’s deck.

When you play this card, you may discard 3 other cards from your hand. If you do, each player discards their Benched Pokémon until they have 3 Benched Pokémon. Your opponent discards first.

name: Chaotic Swell
effect: Whenever either player plays a Stadium card from their hand, discard that Stadium card after discarding this one. (The new Stadium card has no effect.)

name: Clay
effect: Discard the top 7 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Item cards, put them into your hand.

name: Cynthia & Caitlin
effect:
Put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand. You can’t choose Cynthia & Caitlin or a card you discarded with the effect of this card.

When you play this card, you may discard another card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

name: Dragonium Z: Dragon Claw
effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has the Dragon Claw attack, it can use the GX attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)

name: Erika
effect: Each player may draw up to 3 cards. You draw first.

name: Great Catcher
effect:
You can play this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.

Switch 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX with their Active Pokémon.

name: Guzma & Hala
effect:
Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

When you play this card, you may discard 2 other cards from your hand. If you do, you may also search for a Pokémon Tool card and a Special Energy card in this way.

name: Island Challenge Amulet
effect: The Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX this card is attached to gets -100 HP, and when it is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent’s attack, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card.

name: Lana’s Fishing Rod
effect: Shuffle a Pokémon and a Pokémon Tool card from your discard pile into your deck.

name: Lillie’s Full Force
effect:
Draw 4 cards.

At the end of this turn, if you have 3 or more cards in your hand, shuffle cards from your hand into your deck until you have 2 cards in your hand.

name: Lillie’s Poké Doll
effect:
Play this card as if it were a 30-HP Colorless Basic Pokémon. At any time during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may discard all cards from it and put it on the bottom of your deck.

This card can’t retreat. If this card is Knocked Out, your opponent can’t take any Prize cards for it.

name: Mallow & Lana
effect:
Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. 

When you play this card, you may discard 2 other cards from your hand. If you do, heal 120 damage from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench.

name: Misty & Lorelei
effect:
Search your deck for up to 3 Water Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

When you play this card, you may discard 5 other cards from your hand. If you do, during this turn, your Water Pokémon can use their GX attacks even if you have used your GX attack.

name: N’s Resolve
effect: Discard the top 6 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are basic Energy cards, attach them to 1 of your Benched Dragon Pokémon.

name: Professor Oak’s Setup
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon of different types and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Red & Blue
effect:
Search your deck for a Pokémon-GX that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can’t use this card during your first turn or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.)

When you play this card, you may discard 2 other cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to the Pokémon you evolved in this way.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

name: Shuckle
flavor_text: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

name: Lotad
flavor_text: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Lombre
flavor_text: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

name: Ludicolo
flavor_text: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

name: Snover
flavor_text: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

name: Grubbin
flavor_text: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Applin
flavor_text: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Applin
flavor_text: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Flapple
flavor_text: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Appletun
flavor_text: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavor_text: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavor_text: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Magikarp
evolves_to: Dark Gyarados|Giovanni's Gyarados|Gyarados|Gyarados GX|Gyarados ex|Gyarados δ|Misty's Gyarados
flavor_text: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Wingull
flavor_text: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

name: Pelipper
flavor_text: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

name: Galarian Darumaka
flavor_text: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavor_text: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

name: Cramorant
flavor_text: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
flavor_text: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Eiscue
flavor_text: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

name: Charjabug
flavor_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Natu
flavor_text: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavor_text: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

name: Galarian Cursola
flavor_text: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

name: Palossand
flavor_text: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

name: Hatenna
flavor_text: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavor_text: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavor_text: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Milcery
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavor_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Indeedee
flavor_text: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Dreepy
flavor_text: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
flavor_text: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
flavor_text: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Galarian Farfetch'd
flavor_text: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
flavor_text: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

name: Meditite
flavor_text: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
flavor_text: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Barboach
flavor_text: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

name: Whiscash
flavor_text: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

name: Galarian Yamask
flavor_text: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

name: Galarian Runerigus
flavor_text: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Binacle
flavor_text: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavor_text: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Rolycoly
flavor_text: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Carkol
flavor_text: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Coalossal
flavor_text: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Falinks
flavor_text: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Stonjourner
flavor_text: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Galarian Weezing
flavor_text: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

name: Stunky
flavor_text: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

name: Skuntank
flavor_text: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Vullaby
flavor_text: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

name: Mandibuzz
flavor_text: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

name: Impidimp
flavor_text: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
flavor_text: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavor_text: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavor_text: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavor_text: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Scizor
flavor_text: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there's nothing left but scraps.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

name: Durant
flavor_text: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

name: Doublade
flavor_text: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

name: Duraludon
flavor_text: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Zacian
flavor_text: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

name: Zamazenta
flavor_text: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful—several hundred of them can gather at once.

name: Tranquill
flavor_text: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

name: Unfezant
flavor_text: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Stufful
flavor_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavor_text: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

flavor_text: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Parasect

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Pansage
flavor_text: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
flavor_text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Shelmet
flavor_text: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

name: Accelgor
flavor_text: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Decidueye
flavor_text: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

name: Steenee
flavor_text: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

name: Tsareena
flavor_text: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavor_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Torchic
flavor_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Combusken
flavor_text: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Blaziken
flavor_text: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: Heatran
flavor_text: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Pansear
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
flavor_text: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavor_text: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavor_text: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavor_text: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.

name: Panpour
flavor_text: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavor_text: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Galarian Darumaka
flavor_text: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavor_text: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

name: Vanillite
flavor_text: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Vanillish
flavor_text: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

name: Cubchoo
flavor_text: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

name: Wishiwashi
flavor_text: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

name: Mareanie
flavor_text: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Toxapex
flavor_text: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Dracovish
flavor_text: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Arctovish
flavor_text: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Electrike
flavor_text: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavor_text: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

name: Tapu Koko
flavor_text: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

name: Pincurchin
flavor_text: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Dracozolt
flavor_text: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: Arctozolt
flavor_text: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
flavor_text: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

name: Gothitelle
flavor_text: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

name: Golett
flavor_text: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

name: Morelull
flavor_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic
flavor_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

name: Sinistea
flavor_text: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Polteageist
flavor_text: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
evolves_to: Dark Tyranitar|Tyranitar|Tyranitar GX|Tyranitar ex|Tyranitar ex δ|Tyranitar δ
flavor_text: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

name: Vibrava
evolves_to: Flygon|Flygon GX|Flygon ex|Flygon ex δ|Flygon δ
flavor_text: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavor_text: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

name: Passimian
flavor_text: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
flavor_text: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

name: Muk
flavor_text: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Darkrai
flavor_text: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Deino
flavor_text: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Nickit
flavor_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavor_text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

name: Aron
flavor_text: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavor_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Cufant
flavor_text: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Copperajah
flavor_text: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Sentret
flavor_text: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

name: Furret
flavor_text: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavor_text: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Rookidee
flavor_text: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Corvisquire
flavor_text: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corviknight
flavor_text: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Rillaboom
flavor_text: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Coalossal

name: Pikachu on the Ball
artist: Illus. & Direc. The Pokémon Company Art Team
flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Eevee on the Ball
artist: Illus. & Direc. The Pokémon Company Art Team
flavor_text: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Grookey on the Ball
artist: Illus. & Direc. The Pokémon Company Art Team
flavor_text: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Scorbunny on the Ball
artist: Illus. & Direc. The Pokémon Company Art Team
flavor_text: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Sobble on the Ball
artist: Illus. & Direc. The Pokémon Company Art Team
flavor_text: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Victini
flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Sizzlipede
flavor_text: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
flavor_text: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Hatenna
flavor_text: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavor_text: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavor_text: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

name: Rolycoly
flavor_text: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Ekans
flavor_text: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

name: Arbok
flavor_text: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavor_text: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavor_text: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavor_text: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Absol
flavor_text: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: As halfhearted as this Pokémon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

name: Nickit
flavor_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.
