name: Pinsir
flavor_text: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.

name: Hoppip
flavor_text: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skiploom
flavor_text: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Jumpluff
flavor_text: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

name: Seedot
flavor_text: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

name: Dwebble
flavor_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Crustle
flavor_text: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

name: Gossifleur
flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavor_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Applin
flavor_text: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Entei
flavor_text: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Victini
flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: It has been found that its brain cells are 10 times more active when Psyduck is experiencing a headache.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.

name: Lotad
flavor_text: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Lombre
flavor_text: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo
flavor_text: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.

name: Luvdisc
flavor_text: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Bergmite
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.

name: Avalugg
flavor_text: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.

name: Wishiwashi
flavor_text: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Eiscue
flavor_text: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

name: Regieleki
flavor_text: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

name: Galarian Articuno
flavor_text: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Woobat
flavor_text: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Floette
flavor_text: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

name: Florges
flavor_text: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavor_text: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
flavor_text: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Cutiefly
flavor_text: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Ribombee
flavor_text: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Marshadow
flavor_text: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Galarian Zapdos
flavor_text: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.

name: Roggenrola
flavor_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavor_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.

name: Gigalith
flavor_text: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Galarian Moltres
flavor_text: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Zorua
flavor_text: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

name: Zoroark
flavor_text: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

name: Nickit
flavor_text: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Thievul
flavor_text: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Bagon
flavor_text: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

name: Shelgon
evolves_to: Salamence|Salamence GX|Salamence ex|Salamence ex δ|Salamence δ
flavor_text: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.

name: Salamence
flavor_text: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.

name: Dialga
flavor_text: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Deino
flavor_text: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.

name: Kyurem
flavor_text: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Flapple
flavor_text: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Appletun
flavor_text: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Regidrago
flavor_text: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Lillipup
flavor_text: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.

name: Herdier
flavor_text: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

name: Stoutland
flavor_text: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Kyogre
flavor_text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Palkia

name: Zekrom

name: Mew
flavor_text: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

name: Cosmoem
flavor_text: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

name: Lunala
flavor_text: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

name: Groudon
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Dialga
flavor_text: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Solgaleo
flavor_text: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Dark Gyarados

name: Cleffa
flavor_text: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Shining Magikarp
flavor_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Pansage
flavor_text: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
flavor_text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Sewaddle
flavor_text: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
flavor_text: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
flavor_text: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Maractus
flavor_text: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Shelmet
flavor_text: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Accelgor
flavor_text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Virizion
flavor_text: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Grubbin
flavor_text: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Gossifleur
flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavor_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Zarude
flavor_text: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Vulpix

flavor_text: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Ninetales

name: Ninetales

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Victini
flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Pansear
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
flavor_text: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Sizzlipede
flavor_text: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Sizzlipede
flavor_text: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
flavor_text: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Centiskorch
flavor_text: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Shellder
flavor_text: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
flavor_text: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Staryu
evolves_to: Mega Starmie ex|Misty's Starmie|Starmie|Starmie GX|Starmie δ
flavor_text: No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its amazing regenerative powers return it to its previous state in half a day!

name: Starmie
flavor_text: It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim through the water. It always seems to be sending out mysterious radio waves.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

name: Croconaw
evolves_to: Dark Feraligatr|Feraligatr|Feraligatr ex|Feraligatr δ|Mega Feraligatr ex
flavor_text: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Marill
flavor_text: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That's why this Pokémon is never cold.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

name: Qwilfish
flavor_text: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Mantine
flavor_text: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

name: Mudkip
flavor_text: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Marshtomp
flavor_text: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

name: Swampert
flavor_text: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

name: Clamperl
flavor_text: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.

name: Huntail
flavor_text: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

name: Gorebyss
flavor_text: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

name: Panpour
flavor_text: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavor_text: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Basculin
flavor_text: Known for their violence, these Pokémon have the most fights with schools of red-striped Basculin.

name: Galarian Darumaka
flavor_text: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavor_text: Though it has a gentle disposition, it's also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.

name: Clauncher
flavor_text: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it's terrible at swimming straight.

name: Clawitzer
flavor_text: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it's exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.

name: Pyukumuku
flavor_text: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

name: Chewtle
flavor_text: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
flavor_text: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Arrokuda
flavor_text: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
flavor_text: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Snom
flavor_text: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Frosmoth
flavor_text: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

name: Plusle
flavor_text: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
flavor_text: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Charjabug
flavor_text: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

name: Jynx
flavor_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
flavor_text: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavor_text: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

name: Galarian Cursola
flavor_text: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Deoxys
flavor_text: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Munna
flavor_text: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
flavor_text: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

name: Meloetta
flavor_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

name: Palossand
flavor_text: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

name: Indeedee
flavor_text: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

name: Dreepy
flavor_text: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Drakloak
flavor_text: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

name: Dragapult
flavor_text: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: Thanks to its thick claws, it's good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

name: Golem
flavor_text: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Landorus
flavor_text: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Stufful
flavor_text: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Clobbopus
flavor_text: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Grapploct
flavor_text: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Falinks
flavor_text: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Falinks
flavor_text: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavor_text: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavor_text: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavor_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Absol
flavor_text: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.

name: Darkrai
flavor_text: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Zorua
flavor_text: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

name: Zoroark
flavor_text: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

name: Vullaby
flavor_text: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

name: Mandibuzz
flavor_text: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Impidimp
flavor_text: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Morgrem
flavor_text: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavor_text: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavor_text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavor_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Durant
flavor_text: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Corviknight
flavor_text: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

name: Cufant
flavor_text: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Copperajah
flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Latias
flavor_text: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Latios
flavor_text: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Goomy
flavor_text: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.

name: Sliggoo
flavor_text: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.

name: Goodra
flavor_text: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

name: Turtonator
flavor_text: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.

name: Blissey
flavor_text: This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only Chansey that share a strong bond with their Trainer can evolve, so people say.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

name: Eevee

flavor_text: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

name: Stantler
flavor_text: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it's attacked by an enemy.

name: Lopunny
flavor_text: It's notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Rookidee
flavor_text: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Corvisquire
flavor_text: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

name: Wooloo
flavor_text: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Wooloo
flavor_text: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool
flavor_text: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Exeggcute
evolves_to: Alolan Exeggutor|Alolan Exeggutor GX|Alolan Exeggutor ex|Dark Exeggutor|Erika's Exeggutor|Exeggutor|Exeggutor δ|ナッシー[Exeggutor]
flavor_text: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Grotle
flavor_text: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Torterra
flavor_text: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Burmy
flavor_text: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Wormadam
flavor_text: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Mothim
flavor_text: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Monferno
flavor_text: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Infernape
flavor_text: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Staryu
evolves_to: Mega Starmie ex|Misty's Starmie|Starmie|Starmie GX|Starmie δ
flavor_text: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Corphish
flavor_text: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt
flavor_text: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Prinplup
flavor_text: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

name: Empoleon
flavor_text: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Cubchoo
flavor_text: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

name: Eiscue
flavor_text: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Milcery
flavor_text: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Alcremie
flavor_text: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

name: Vibrava
evolves_to: Flygon|Flygon GX|Flygon ex|Flygon ex δ|Flygon δ
flavor_text: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavor_text: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

name: Wormadam
flavor_text: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

name: Throh
flavor_text: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.

name: Sawk
flavor_text: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.

name: Golett
flavor_text: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

name: Muk
flavor_text: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Impidimp
flavor_text: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
flavor_text: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavor_text: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Wormadam
flavor_text: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

name: Heatran
flavor_text: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavor_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Gible
flavor_text: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

name: Axew
flavor_text: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

name: Haxorus
flavor_text: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Castform
flavor_text: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Bibarel
flavor_text: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Tornadus
flavor_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Alcremie
flavor_text: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Hisuian Voltorb
flavor_text: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Hisuian Electrode
flavor_text: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Kricketot
flavor_text: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Kricketune
flavor_text: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

name: Combee
flavor_text: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.

name: Vespiquen
flavor_text: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Hisuian Lilligant
flavor_text: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Quilava
flavor_text: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Radiant Heatran
flavor_text: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

name: Swinub
flavor_text: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

name: Piloswine
flavor_text: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Mamoswine
flavor_text: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Mantine
flavor_text: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Barboach
flavor_text: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

name: Whiscash
flavor_text: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

name: Regice
flavor_text: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

name: Glaceon
flavor_text: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

name: Oshawott
flavor_text: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop.".

name: Dewott
flavor_text: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Hisuian Basculin
flavor_text: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Hisuian Basculegion
flavor_text: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Radiant Greninja
flavor_text: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Bergmite
flavor_text: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Hisuian Avalugg
flavor_text: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Regieleki
flavor_text: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

name: Hisuian Typhlosion
flavor_text: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
flavor_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Kirlia
evolves_to: Gallade|Gardevoir|Gardevoir GX|Gardevoir ex|Gardevoir ex δ|Gardevoir δ|Gardevoir-GX|Mega Gallade ex|Mega Gardevoir ex
flavor_text: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gallade
flavor_text: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

name: Uxie
flavor_text: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

name: Mesprit
flavor_text: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

name: Azelf
flavor_text: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

name: Diancie
flavor_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Wyrdeer
flavor_text: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Hisuian Growlithe
flavor_text: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavor_text: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Regirock
flavor_text: Every bit of Regirock's body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what's been lost.

name: Cranidos
flavor_text: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.

name: Rampardos
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

name: Radiant Hawlucha
flavor_text: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Hisuian Decidueye
flavor_text: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Kleavor
flavor_text: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Kleavor
flavor_text: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Hisuian Qwilfish
flavor_text: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Hisuian Qwilfish
flavor_text: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Hisuian Overqwil
flavor_text: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Hisuian Overqwil
flavor_text: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Hisuian Sneasel
flavor_text: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Hisuian Sneasler
flavor_text: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Hisuian Samurott
flavor_text: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Nickit
flavor_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavor_text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

name: Registeel
flavor_text: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

name: Shieldon
flavor_text: Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.

name: Bastiodon
flavor_text: This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

name: Regidrago
flavor_text: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
