name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Ursaluna
flavor_text: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Stantler
flavor_text: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Glameow
flavor_text: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Purugly
flavor_text: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

name: Regigigas
flavor_text: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Hisuian Braviary
flavor_text: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

flavor_text: The Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

name: Frosmoth
flavor_text: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Gardevoir
flavor_text: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Wyrdeer
flavor_text: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Falinks
flavor_text: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Kleavor
flavor_text: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavor_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
flavor_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Radiant Venusaur
flavor_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charizard

name: Radiant Charizard
flavor_text: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Numel
flavor_text: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Radiant Blastoise
flavor_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

name: Magikarp

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavor_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

flavor_text: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Natu
flavor_text: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Sylveon
flavor_text: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

name: Onix
flavor_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar

flavor_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

flavor_text: Night after night, they sneak into people's homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavor_text: It commands a nest of Rattata. Different nests don't get along, whipping up severe fights over feeding grounds.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

name: Blissey
flavor_text: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

name: Sunflora
flavor_text: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Hisuian Lilligant
flavor_text: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Foongus
flavor_text: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

name: Amoonguss
flavor_text: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

name: Durant
flavor_text: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Virizion
flavor_text: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

name: Radiant Tsareena
flavor_text: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Victini
flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
flavor_text: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
flavor_text: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

name: Litten
flavor_text: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

name: Torracat
flavor_text: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

name: Incineroar
flavor_text: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

name: Glalie
flavor_text: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

name: Froslass
flavor_text: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Phione
flavor_text: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Radiant Alakazam
flavor_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn't deal well with folks who aren't easily frightened.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
evolves_to: Gallade|Gardevoir|Gardevoir GX|Gardevoir ex|Gardevoir ex δ|Gardevoir δ|Gardevoir-GX|Mega Gallade ex|Mega Gardevoir ex
flavor_text: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gardevoir
flavor_text: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Meditite
flavor_text: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
flavor_text: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

name: Solosis
flavor_text: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

name: Duosion
flavor_text: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

name: Indeedee
flavor_text: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Dreepy
flavor_text: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
flavor_text: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
flavor_text: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
flavor_text: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Anorith
flavor_text: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

name: Armaldo
flavor_text: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

name: Palossand
flavor_text: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

name: Stonjourner
flavor_text: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

name: Mareanie
flavor_text: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Toxapex
flavor_text: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.

name: Metang
flavor_text: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

name: Radiant Jirachi
flavor_text: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavor_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

name: Dragonair
evolves_to: Dark Dragonite|Dragonite|Dragonite GX|Dragonite ex|Dragonite ex δ|Dragonite δ|Light Dragonite|Mega Dragonite ex
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: It's a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

name: Noivern
flavor_text: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Spinda
flavor_text: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

name: Swablu
flavor_text: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

name: Lopunny
flavor_text: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

name: Archen
flavor_text: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

name: Archeops
flavor_text: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Hisuian Braviary
flavor_text: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

name: Malamar

name: Smeargle

name: Altaria

name: Oddish
flavor_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom

flavor_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Bellossom
flavor_text: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth
flavor_text: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Kricketot
flavor_text: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Grubbin
flavor_text: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Zarude
flavor_text: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: Calyrex
flavor_text: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

name: Radiant Charizard
flavor_text: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Entei
flavor_text: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it's trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

name: Volcanion
flavor_text: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

name: Seel
flavor_text: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavor_text: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Corphish
flavor_text: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Luvdisc
flavor_text: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

name: Kyogre
flavor_text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

name: Radiant Charjabug
flavor_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Pincurchin
flavor_text: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Exeggcute
evolves_to: Alolan Exeggutor|Alolan Exeggutor GX|Alolan Exeggutor ex|Dark Exeggutor|Erika's Exeggutor|Exeggutor|Exeggutor δ|ナッシー[Exeggutor]
flavor_text: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Tapu Lele
flavor_text: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Enamorus
flavor_text: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

name: Dragalge
flavor_text: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavor_text: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavor_text: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Scizor
flavor_text: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

name: Aron
flavor_text: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

name: Metang
flavor_text: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Pawniard

name: Bisharp

name: Zacian
flavor_text: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

name: Zamazenta
flavor_text: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Radiant Eternatus
flavor_text: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Yungoos
flavor_text: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
flavor_text: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Oranguru
flavor_text: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

name: Wooloo
flavor_text: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Dubwool
flavor_text: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: Magmortar

name: Oricorio

name: Lapras

name: Keldeo

name: Electivire

name: Toxtricity

name: Mew

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Deoxys
flavor_text: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Diancie
flavor_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Comfey
flavor_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

name: Altaria

name: Latias

name: Hisuian Goodra

name: Ditto

name: Dunsparce

name: Miltank

name: Duskull

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavor_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavor_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Smoliv
flavor_text: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
flavor_text: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavor_text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Capsakid
flavor_text: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Capsakid

name: Scovillain
flavor_text: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon

flavor_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Entei
flavor_text: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Numel
flavor_text: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

name: Charcadet
flavor_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
flavor_text: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Cubchoo
flavor_text: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 600 metres in a minute's time.

name: Wiglett
flavor_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
flavor_text: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Finizen
flavor_text: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Finizen
flavor_text: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Palafin
flavor_text: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Thundurus
flavor_text: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

name: Tadbulb
flavor_text: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Tadbulb
flavor_text: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Tadbulb

name: Bellibolt
flavor_text: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Bellibolt
flavor_text: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Cleffa
flavor_text: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

name: Togetic
flavor_text: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

name: Espeon
flavor_text: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
flavor_text: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Spoink
flavor_text: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

name: Grumpig
flavor_text: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Sinistea
flavor_text: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

name: Polteageist
flavor_text: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

name: Greavard
flavor_text: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: Greavard
flavor_text: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: Houndstone
flavor_text: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar
evolves_to: Dark Tyranitar|Tyranitar|Tyranitar GX|Tyranitar ex|Tyranitar ex δ|Tyranitar δ
flavor_text: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

name: Barboach
flavor_text: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

name: Whiscash
flavor_text: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

name: Bonsly
flavor_text: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Crabrawler
flavor_text: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

name: Crabominable
flavor_text: The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

name: Toedscool
flavor_text: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

name: Toedscruel
flavor_text: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

name: Glimmet
flavor_text: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Glimmet
flavor_text: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavor_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavor_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Paldean Clodsire
flavor_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: Paldean Clodsire
flavor_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: Umbreon
flavor_text: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Darkrai
flavor_text: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Scizor
flavor_text: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: People fashion swords from Skarmory's shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

name: Kingambit
flavor_text: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

name: Varoom
flavor_text: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Varoom
flavor_text: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

name: Dragonair
evolves_to: Dark Dragonite|Dragonite|Dragonite GX|Dragonite ex|Dragonite ex δ|Dragonite δ|Light Dragonite|Mega Dragonite ex
flavor_text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

flavor_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Zigzagoon
flavor_text: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Linoone
flavor_text: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Lillipup
flavor_text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won't forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Herdier
flavor_text: The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Stoutland
flavor_text: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It's said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

name: Audino
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.

name: Bouffalant
flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Yungoos
flavor_text: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

name: Gumshoos
flavor_text: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

name: Lechonk
flavor_text: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

name: Oinkologne
flavor_text: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: Oinkologne
flavor_text: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

name: Flamigo
flavor_text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
