name: Weedle
flavor_text: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

name: Fearow
flavor_text: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Ekans
flavor_text: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Nidoran♀
flavor_text: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

name: Nidoran♂
flavor_text: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
evolves_to: Bellossom|Bellossom δ|Dark Vileplume|Erika's Vileplume|Vileplume|Vileplume GX|Vileplume ex|Vileplume δ
flavor_text: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Paras
flavor_text: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

name: Abra
flavor_text: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

name: Kadabra
flavor_text: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

name: Slowpoke
evolves_to: Dark Slowbro|Dark Slowking|Light Slowbro|Mega Slowbro ex|Sabrina's Slowbro|Slowbro|Slowking|Slowking ex
flavor_text: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Seel
flavor_text: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
flavor_text: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Shellder
flavor_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavor_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
evolves_to: Dark Gengar|Gengar|Gengar ex|Mega Gengar ex|Sabrina's Gengar
flavor_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Krabby
flavor_text: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
flavor_text: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

name: Voltorb
evolves_to: Dark Electrode|Electrode|Electrode GX|Electrode ex|Electrode-GX|Lt. Surge's Electrode
flavor_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Exeggcute
evolves_to: Alolan Exeggutor|Alolan Exeggutor GX|Alolan Exeggutor ex|Dark Exeggutor|Erika's Exeggutor|Exeggutor|Exeggutor δ|ナッシー[Exeggutor]
flavor_text: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

name: Cubone
evolves_to: Alolan Marowak|Alolan Marowak GX|Dark Marowak|Marowak|Marowak δ
flavor_text: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Weezing
flavor_text: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

name: Seadra
evolves_to: Kingdra|Kingdra GX|Kingdra ex|Kingdra ex δ|Kingdra δ
flavor_text: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Staryu
evolves_to: Mega Starmie ex|Misty's Starmie|Starmie|Starmie GX|Starmie δ
flavor_text: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: With the coming of a storm, many of these Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there waiting for lightning to strike.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Magikarp
evolves_to: Dark Gyarados|Giovanni's Gyarados|Gyarados|Gyarados GX|Gyarados ex|Gyarados δ|Misty's Gyarados
flavor_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

name: Eevee
evolves_to: Dark Espeon|Dark Flareon|Dark Jolteon|Dark Vaporeon|Espeon|Espeon GX|Espeon ex|Espeon δ|Espeon-GX|Flareon|Flareon GX|Flareon ex|Flareon δ|Glaceon|Glaceon GX|Glaceon ex|Glaceon-GX|Jolteon|Jolteon GX|Jolteon ex|Jolteon δ|Leafeon|Leafeon GX|Leafeon ex|Leafeon-GX|Light Flareon|Light Jolteon|Light Vaporeon|Lt. Surge's Jolteon|Sylveon|Sylveon GX|Sylveon ex|Sylveon-GX|Umbreon|Umbreon GX|Umbreon ex|Umbreon δ|Umbreon-GX|Vaporeon|Vaporeon GX|Vaporeon ex|Vaporeon δ
flavor_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

name: Omanyte
flavor_text: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.

name: Omastar
flavor_text: Omastar's sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

name: Kabuto
flavor_text: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

name: Kabutops
flavor_text: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

name: Aerodactyl
flavor_text: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

name: Dragonair
evolves_to: Dark Dragonite|Dragonite|Dragonite GX|Dragonite ex|Dragonite ex δ|Dragonite δ|Light Dragonite|Mega Dragonite ex
flavor_text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Pansage
flavor_text: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
flavor_text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Dwebble
flavor_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Crustle
flavor_text: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled- down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavor_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Blipbug
flavor_text: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
flavor_text: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
flavor_text: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Nymble
flavor_text: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Nymble
flavor_text: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Toedscool
flavor_text: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscool
flavor_text: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscruel
flavor_text: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Wo-Chien
flavor_text: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Magby
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes. At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma, resting and recovering from the day's fatigue.

name: Pansear
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
flavor_text: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Volcanion
flavor_text: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Fuecoco
flavor_text: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Crocalor
flavor_text: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

name: Charcadet
flavor_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Charcadet
flavor_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Iron Moth
flavor_text: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Chi-Yu
flavor_text: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

name: Seadra
evolves_to: Kingdra|Kingdra GX|Kingdra ex|Kingdra ex δ|Kingdra δ
flavor_text: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they've been given to royalty as gifts.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

name: Mantyke
flavor_text: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they'll all fight together to repel attackers.

name: Palkia
flavor_text: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Panpour
flavor_text: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavor_text: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Vanillite
flavor_text: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
flavor_text: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.

name: Golisopod
flavor_text: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner's meal.

name: Wiglett
flavor_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wiglett
flavor_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
flavor_text: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Veluza
flavor_text: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

name: Dondozo
flavor_text: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

name: Iron Bundle
flavor_text: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Chien-Pao
flavor_text: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

name: Elekid
flavor_text: It's not good at storing electricity yet. This Pokémon sneaks into people's homes, looking for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.

name: Plusle
flavor_text: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
flavor_text: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik
flavor_text: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They're often found sticking to Yamper's hindquarters.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: The energetic, cheerful dance of these Oricorio is popular with children, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Natu
flavor_text: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

name: Latios
flavor_text: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Deoxys
flavor_text: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Yamask
flavor_text: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavor_text: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
flavor_text: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Flittle
flavor_text: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Flittle
flavor_text: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Espathra
flavor_text: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Tinkatink
flavor_text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatink
flavor_text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
flavor_text: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkaton
flavor_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Scream Tail
flavor_text: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

name: Gimmighoul
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Gimmighoul
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Groudon
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Minior
flavor_text: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.

name: Nacli
flavor_text: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Nacli
flavor_text: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Naclstack
flavor_text: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

name: Garganacl
flavor_text: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Klawf
flavor_text: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Flamigo
flavor_text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Slither Wing
flavor_text: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

name: Ting-Lu
flavor_text: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Nickit
flavor_text: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Thievul
flavor_text: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

name: Lokix
flavor_text: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Brute Bonnet
flavor_text: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Jirachi
flavor_text: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Durant
flavor_text: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

name: Doublade
flavor_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Doublade
flavor_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Zacian
flavor_text: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Orthworm
flavor_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

name: Tatsugiri
flavor_text: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

name: Porygon2
flavor_text: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor_text: Some say an additional program made this Pokémon evolve, but even academics can't agree on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Whismur
flavor_text: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it's exhausted, then it falls asleep.

name: Loudred
flavor_text: The force of this Pokémon's loud voice isn't just the sound—it's also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

name: Exploud
flavor_text: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it'll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

name: Spinda
flavor_text: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Tandemaus
flavor_text: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Tandemaus
flavor_text: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Cyclizar
flavor_text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Iron Jugulis
flavor_text: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Luxurious Cape
effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn't have a Rule Box, it gets +100 HP, and if it is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, that player takes 1 more Prize card. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

name: Mela

You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.

Attach a Basic {R} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

name: Norman
effect: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, draw 2 more cards.

name: Parasol Lady
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If you go second and it's your first turn, draw 8 cards instead.

name: Professor Sada's Vitality
effect: Choose up to 2 of your Ancient Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you attached any Energy in this way, draw 3 cards.

name: Professor Turo's Scenario
effect: Put 1 of your Pokémon in play into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)

name: Rika
effect: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.

name: Roark
effect: Draw 2 cards. Put a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Shauntal
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If tails, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Snorlax Doll
effect:
If this card is in your hand when you are setting up to play, you may put it face down in the Active Spot or on your Bench as if it were a 120-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. (You can do this only when you are setting up to play.) At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.

This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. If this card is Knocked Out, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

name: Technical Machine: Turbo Energize

effect:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Search your deck for up to 2 Future Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Tulip
effect: Put up to 4 in any combination of {P} Pokémon and Basic {P} Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Medical Energy
effect:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, heal 30 damage from that Pokémon.

flavor_text: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

name: Nacli
flavor_text: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Naclstack
flavor_text: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

name: Garganacl
flavor_text: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Glimmet
flavor_text: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavor_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

name: Kingambit
flavor_text: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Mabosstiff
flavor_text: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Shroodle
flavor_text: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Grafaiai
flavor_text: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Scizor
flavor_text: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

name: Varoom
flavor_text: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Revavroom
flavor_text: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

name: Cyclizar
flavor_text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Wingull
flavor_text: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

name: Pelipper
flavor_text: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

name: Greedent
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Lechonk
flavor_text: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

name: Oinkologne
flavor_text: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

name: Tandemaus
flavor_text: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: Maushold
flavor_text: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Flamigo
flavor_text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Wugtrio
flavor_text: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Palafin
flavor_text: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

name: Pawmi
flavor_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Penny

name: Scyther
flavor_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Pineco
flavor_text: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

name: Seedot
flavor_text: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

name: Roselia
flavor_text: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

name: Roserade
flavor_text: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

name: Grotle
flavor_text: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

name: Deerling
flavor_text: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

name: Sawsbuck
flavor_text: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

name: Grubbin
flavor_text: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Dhelmise
flavor_text: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Bramblin
flavor_text: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
flavor_text: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Rellor
flavor_text: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Rabsca
flavor_text: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Victini
flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Litten
flavor_text: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

name: Torracat
flavor_text: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat's neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.

name: Turtonator
flavor_text: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Sizzlipede
flavor_text: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
flavor_text: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
evolves_to: Dark Feraligatr|Feraligatr|Feraligatr ex|Feraligatr δ|Mega Feraligatr ex
flavor_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: It won't attack while it's alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle, filling its body with power and changing its form.

name: Snom
flavor_text: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

name: Frosmoth
flavor_text: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

name: Wiglett
flavor_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Finizen
flavor_text: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Palafin
flavor_text: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ
flavor_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Charjabug
flavor_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Yamper
flavor_text: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: Boltund
flavor_text: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Iron Hands
flavor_text: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Thorns
flavor_text: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: Girafarig's tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

name: Latias
flavor_text: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Solosis
flavor_text: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

name: Duosion
flavor_text: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

name: Cutiefly
flavor_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

name: Ribombee
flavor_text: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Scream Tail
flavor_text: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

name: Flutter Mane
flavor_text: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

name: Iron Valiant
flavor_text: It's possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Valiant
flavor_text: It's possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Meditite
flavor_text: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

name: Medicham
flavor_text: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

name: Golett
flavor_text: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

name: Mudbray
flavor_text: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won't dry out even if it's exposed to the sun for a long time.

name: Mudsdale
flavor_text: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

name: Rolycoly
flavor_text: On sunny days, Rolycoly will come out onto grassy plains and roll around. Then it will eat the grass that gets tangled in its wheel-like leg.

name: Carkol
flavor_text: The temperature inside its body increases when it experiences strong emotions. It rolls around frantically while spewing flames.

name: Coalossal
flavor_text: To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from its smoldering back.

name: Great Tusk
flavor_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

name: Great Tusk
flavor_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

name: Sandy Shocks
flavor_text: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

name: Ekans
flavor_text: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
flavor_text: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
evolves_to: Dark Gengar|Gengar|Gengar ex|Mega Gengar ex|Sabrina's Gengar
flavor_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Roaring Moon
flavor_text: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

name: Forretress
flavor_text: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.

name: Metang
flavor_text: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Iron Treads
flavor_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Koraidon
flavor_text: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Miraidon
flavor_text: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Dudunsparce
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

name: Tranquill
flavor_text: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

name: Unfezant
flavor_text: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Iron Jugulis
flavor_text: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Grotle
flavor_text: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

name: Deerling
flavor_text: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

name: Sawsbuck
flavor_text: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

name: Litten
flavor_text: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

name: Snom
flavor_text: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

name: Charjabug
flavor_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

name: Cutiefly
flavor_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

name: Mudsdale
flavor_text: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

name: Arbok
flavor_text: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.
