name: Tangela
flavor_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth
flavor_text: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: Some fishers weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It wanders in search of food after darkness falls, never nesting in a specific place.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

name: Sunflora
flavor_text: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

name: Volbeat
flavor_text: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise
flavor_text: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text: The younger they are, the more they smell like fresh grass. With age, their fragrance takes on the odor of fallen leaves.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the forest. It doesn't even care if these Pokémon take up residence in the greenery on its head.

name: Grookey
flavor_text: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Thwackey
flavor_text: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Rillaboom
flavor_text: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Applin
flavor_text: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

name: Dipplin
flavor_text: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Iron Leaves
flavor_text: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Poltchageist
flavor_text: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Poltchageist
flavor_text: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
flavor_text: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Teal Mask Ogerpon
flavor_text: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: It's said that in ancient times, when volcanoes were more active, there were many more Slugma than there are now.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

name: Monferno
flavor_text: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

name: Infernape
flavor_text: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life-force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: It absorbs spirits, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Chi-Yu
flavor_text: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Its legs are newly grown, and it can't walk very well. It seems to prefer swimming through the water instead.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: Its skin is moist all over its body. The skin on its belly spiral also feels smooth.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Corphish
flavor_text: It can live in impure water, where it doesn't need to compete with other water Pokémon for food, so its numbers have steadily increased.

name: Crawdaunt
flavor_text: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of war, it shows itself, which soothes people's minds and hearts.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will prosper. It can withstand cold of −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Glalie
flavor_text: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

name: Froslass
flavor_text: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Glaceon
flavor_text: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

name: Phione
flavor_text: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Cramorant
flavor_text: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain. It focuses on battling instead.

name: Finizen
flavor_text: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin
flavor_text: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen's, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

name: Iron Bundle
flavor_text: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Walking Wake
flavor_text: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it's in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

name: Tadbulb
flavor_text: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Bellibolt
flavor_text: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.

name: Wattrel
flavor_text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.

name: Kilowattrel
flavor_text: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Abra
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

name: Kadabra
flavor_text: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Alakazam
flavor_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: Girafarig's tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

name: Farigiraf
flavor_text: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

name: Floette
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

name: Florges
flavor_text: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they're blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

name: Palossand
flavor_text: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.

name: Enamorus
flavor_text: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Munkidori
flavor_text: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Fezandipiti
flavor_text: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: No matter how high a place it falls from, this Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

name: Hisuian Growlithe
flavor_text: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavor_text: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: When endangered, it may protect itself by increasing its magnetism and drawing nearby iron objects to its body.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances are rendered useless while it's around.

name: Timburr
flavor_text: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
flavor_text: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor_text: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Glimmet
flavor_text: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
flavor_text: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Ting-Lu
flavor_text: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Okidogi
flavor_text: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: Once it's caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack moves out.

name: Venipede
flavor_text: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

name: Whirlipede
flavor_text: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

name: Scolipede
flavor_text: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws' toxic spikes.

name: Brute Bonnet
flavor_text: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: People fashion swords from Skarmory's shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Aron
flavor_text: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

name: Heatran
flavor_text: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Varoom
flavor_text: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
flavor_text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Applin
flavor_text: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

name: Dipplin
flavor_text: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Dreepy
flavor_text: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: Drakloak
flavor_text: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.

name: Tatsugiri
flavor_text: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: It's said that many artists have taken inspiration from the sight of a Swanna performing a beautiful dance in the light of dawn.

flavor_text: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

name: Lotad
flavor_text: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

name: Lombre
flavor_text: It prefers waterfronts with plentiful food. It became nocturnal so it wouldn't have to compete for food with bird Pokémon.

name: Ludicolo
flavor_text: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

name: Genesect
flavor_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Nymble
flavor_text: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Lokix
flavor_text: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

name: Charmeleon
evolves_to: Blaine's Charizard|Charizard|Charizard GX|Charizard ex|Charizard δ|Charizard-GX|Dark Charizard|Mega Charizard X ex|Mega Charizard Y ex|Special Delivery Charizard
flavor_text: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: Charcadet
flavor_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Ceruledge
flavor_text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Seel
flavor_text: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

name: Swinub
flavor_text: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

name: Piloswine
flavor_text: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

name: Mamoswine
flavor_text: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Prinplup
flavor_text: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

name: Yamper
flavor_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
flavor_text: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Pawmi
flavor_text: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavor_text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
flavor_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

name: Granbull
flavor_text: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

name: Cresselia
flavor_text: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Meloetta
flavor_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Milcery
flavor_text: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

name: Alcremie
flavor_text: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

name: Zacian
flavor_text: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Bramblin
flavor_text: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast
flavor_text: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent's weak spots.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

name: Vibrava
evolves_to: Flygon|Flygon GX|Flygon ex|Flygon ex δ|Flygon δ
flavor_text: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

name: Flygon
flavor_text: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
evolves_to: Dark Gengar|Gengar|Gengar ex|Mega Gengar ex|Sabrina's Gengar
flavor_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Seviper
flavor_text: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

name: Eternatus
flavor_text: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Duraludon
flavor_text: Duraludon's body is comprised of a special metal that's lightweight and scratch resistant. It's also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

name: Archaludon
flavor_text: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

name: Zigzagoon
flavor_text: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Linoone
flavor_text: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Erika's Oddish
flavor_text: When it is woken by moonlight, it wanders about. But during the day, it stays still underground.

name: Erika's Gloom
flavor_text: It secretes a sticky, drool-like nectar. Though sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.

name: Erika's Bellsprout
flavor_text: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Erika's Weepinbell
flavor_text: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Erika's Tangela
flavor_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Chikorita
flavor_text: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Wurmple
flavor_text: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

name: Silcoon
flavor_text: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

name: Beautifly
flavor_text: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

name: Cascoon
flavor_text: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

name: Dustox
flavor_text: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Budew
flavor_text: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

name: Grubbin
flavor_text: It spits sticky threads and winds them around branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree in a pendulum-like motion.

name: Team Rocket's Tarountula
flavor_text: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

name: Team Rocket's Spidops
flavor_text: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmeleon
evolves_to: Blaine's Charizard|Charizard|Charizard GX|Charizard ex|Charizard δ|Charizard-GX|Dark Charizard|Mega Charizard X ex|Mega Charizard Y ex|Special Delivery Charizard
flavor_text: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Ethan's Slugma
flavor_text: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

name: Ethan's Magcargo
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

name: Entei
flavor_text: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Numel
flavor_text: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Tepig
flavor_text: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavor_text: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

name: N's Darumaka
flavor_text: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

name: N's Darmanitan
flavor_text: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

name: Scorbunny
flavor_text: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Raboot
flavor_text: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
evolves_to: Dark Feraligatr|Feraligatr|Feraligatr ex|Feraligatr δ|Mega Feraligatr ex
flavor_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

name: N's Vanillite
flavor_text: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: N's Vanillish
flavor_text: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Snom
flavor_text: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Frosmoth
flavor_text: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

name: Glastrier
flavor_text: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Pikachu
evolves_to: Alolan Raichu|Dark Raichu|Lt. Surge's Raichu|Pikachu|Raichu|Raichu GX|Raichu ex|Raichu δ

name: Raichu
flavor_text: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Charjabug
flavor_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Tapu Koko
flavor_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Iono's Tadbulb
flavor_text: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Iono's Wattrel
flavor_text: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Iono's Kilowattrel
flavor_text: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Team Rocket's Exeggcute
flavor_text: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

name: Team Rocket's Exeggutor
flavor_text: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavor_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia
evolves_to: Gallade|Gardevoir|Gardevoir GX|Gardevoir ex|Gardevoir ex δ|Gardevoir δ|Gardevoir-GX|Mega Gallade ex|Mega Gardevoir ex
flavor_text: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Shuppet
flavor_text: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Banette
flavor_text: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Hop's Phantump
flavor_text: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Hop's Trevenant
flavor_text: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Spectrier
flavor_text: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Munkidori
flavor_text: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Team Rocket's Diglett
flavor_text: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio
flavor_text: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Groudon
flavor_text: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Cynthia's Gible
flavor_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Cynthia's Gabite
flavor_text: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Rolycoly
flavor_text: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

name: Carkol
flavor_text: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Coalossal
flavor_text: It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

name: Okidogi
flavor_text: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
evolves_to: Dark Gengar|Gengar|Gengar ex|Mega Gengar ex|Sabrina's Gengar
flavor_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Team Rocket's Murkrow
flavor_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Team Rocket's Honchkrow
flavor_text: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavor_text: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavor_text: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavor_text: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
flavor_text: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: N's Zorua
flavor_text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Vullaby
flavor_text: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Pecharunt
flavor_text: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

name: Kingambit
flavor_text: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

name: Dragonair
evolves_to: Dark Dragonite|Dragonite|Dragonite GX|Dragonite ex|Dragonite ex δ|Dragonite δ|Light Dragonite|Mega Dragonite ex
flavor_text: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

name: Rayquaza
flavor_text: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: N's Reshiram
flavor_text: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: N's Zekrom
flavor_text: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Noivern
flavor_text: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Dreepy
flavor_text: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: Drakloak
flavor_text: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up.

name: Team Rocket's Meowth
flavor_text: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Larry's Dunsparce
flavor_text: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Larry's Starly
flavor_text: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Larry's Staravia
flavor_text: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Larry's Staraptor
flavor_text: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Fan Rotom
flavor_text: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

name: Larry's Rufflet
flavor_text: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

name: Larry's Braviary
flavor_text: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Larry's Komala
flavor_text: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Hop's Cramorant
flavor_text: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They’re at their most formidable when they’re struggling to swallow overly large prey.

name: Terapagos
flavor_text: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

flavor_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Beautifly
flavor_text: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

name: Dustox
flavor_text: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Budew
flavor_text: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

name: Ethan's Magcargo
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

name: Numel

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

name: Scorbunny
flavor_text: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Psyduck
evolves_to: Dark Golduck|Golduck|Golduck δ|Light Golduck|Misty's Golduck|Sabrina's Golduck
flavor_text: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Iono's Wattrel
flavor_text: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Banette
flavor_text: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Slurpuff

name: Hop's Trevenant

name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu

name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Chespin
flavor_text: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Quilladin
flavor_text: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

name: Chesnaught
flavor_text: Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Ho-Oh
flavor_text: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Braixen
flavor_text: It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Delphox
flavor_text: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Delibird
flavor_text: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle filling its body with power and changing its form.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Bergmite
flavor_text: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

name: Avalugg
flavor_text: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: It's nature's cleaner-it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavor_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its patagial membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Deoxys
flavor_text: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavor_text: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text: It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.

name: Donphan
flavor_text: Donphan is normally a calm Pokemon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

name: Qwilfish
flavor_text: Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish in the brief moment that these Pokemon become defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.

name: Stunky
flavor_text: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

name: Skuntank
flavor_text: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, this Pokemon sprays liquid poison to take down prey that approach unawares.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: They communicate with one another by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

name: Metang
flavor_text: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Goomy
flavor_text: Thanks to the slimy membrane covering its body punches or kicks from its enemies slide right off it.

name: Sliggoo
flavor_text: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

name: Goodra
flavor_text: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protectors take pride in their battle-scarred horns.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: Using luminescent matter within its body, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: These Pokemon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

name: Volbeat
flavor_text: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise
flavor_text: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim
flavor_text: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Vivillon
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born in a special land. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: Vulpix
evolves_to: Blaine's Ninetales|Brock's Ninetales|Light Ninetales|Ninetales|Ninetales ex|Ninetales δ
flavor_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Ho-Oh
flavor_text: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Victini
flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Slowpoke
evolves_to: Dark Slowbro|Dark Slowking|Light Slowbro|Mega Slowbro ex|Sabrina's Slowbro|Slowbro|Slowking|Slowking ex
flavor_text: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Kyogre
flavor_text: In myths, this Pokémon expanded the seas with torrential rains and great tsunamis. It battled ferociously against Groudon.

name: Palkia
flavor_text: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

name: Wishiwashi
flavor_text: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

name: Zekrom

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: As it gulps down stagnant water and generates electricity in its body, a sound like a rhythm played by a bass guitar reverberates all around.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

name: Miraidon
flavor_text: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: Created from the DNA of Mew, this Pokémon is a dangerous combination of overwhelming power and a savage heart.

name: Mew
flavor_text: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

name: Espeon
flavor_text: It uses the fine fur on its body to sense movement in the air and predict the weather...as well as its foes' thoughts.

name: Unown
flavor_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

name: Cresselia
flavor_text: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Comfey
flavor_text: It prefers areas with lots of flowers. A Comfey adorned with flowers is a happy Comfey, and the flowers gain healing effects.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

name: Cosmoem
flavor_text: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

name: Lunala
flavor_text: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

name: Gimmighoul
flavor_text: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

name: Groudon
flavor_text: Groudon is said to have expanded the reach of dry land by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled ferociously against Kyogre.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.

name: Koraidon
flavor_text: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Nidoran♀
flavor_text: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they'll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get poked while their mother is feeding them.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavor_text: It's accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it's very picky about food.

name: Umbreon
flavor_text: The light of the moon changed Eevee's genetic structure. It lurks in the darkness, waiting for prey.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Zorua
flavor_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark
flavor_text: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Deino
flavor_text: It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce, so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that moves and attempt to eat it.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: The two heads have different likes and dislikes. Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: It's said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because people in times long past loathed it, considering it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: It's said that when its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavor_text: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Dialga
flavor_text: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Solgaleo
flavor_text: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

name: Zacian
flavor_text: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Zamazenta
flavor_text: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Gholdengo
flavor_text: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Jangmo-o
flavor_text: They communicate with their allies using the sounds their scales make when struck. A group of these Pokémon causes quite a racket.

name: Hakamo-o
flavor_text: It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.

name: Kommo-o
flavor_text: It bashes its scales to test its opponents' mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.
