name: Poké Ball
effect: Put a random Basic Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavor_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

name: Maractus
flavor_text: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Grubbin
flavor_text: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Fomantis
flavor_text: Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.

name: Lurantis
flavor_text: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

name: Morelull
flavor_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic
flavor_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavor_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavor_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything,  including garbage and rotten things. The ground near  its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavor_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavor_text: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavor_text: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

name: Litten
flavor_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Litten
flavor_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavor_text: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they've grown close, but it's a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Turtonator
flavor_text: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Alolan Sandshrew
flavor_text: Life on mountains covered with deep snow has granted this Pokémon a body of ice that's as hard as steel.

name: Alolan Sandslash
flavor_text: It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text: After long years in the ever-snowcapped mountains of Alola, this Vulpix has gained power over ice.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavor_text: A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped as that deity's incarnation.

name: Shellder
flavor_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavor_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Popplio
flavor_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Popplio
flavor_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavor_text: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn't know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Primarina
flavor_text: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

name: Wishiwashi
flavor_text: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Pyukumuku
flavor_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Bruxish
flavor_text: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

name: Tapu Fini
flavor_text: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Alolan Geodude
flavor_text: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

name: Alolan Graveler
flavor_text:
When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the
surroundings with flashes of light and sound.
People call it the “fireworks of the earth.”

name: Alolan Golem
flavor_text: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Charjabug
flavor_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavor_text: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Tapu Koko
flavor_text: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Spoink
flavor_text: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

name: Grumpig
flavor_text: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Shuppet
flavor_text: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Banette
flavor_text: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the spirits of the dead.

name: Cutiefly
flavor_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

name: Ribombee
flavor_text: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Comfey
flavor_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
flavor_text: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu's old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Tapu Lele
flavor_text: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Cosmoem
flavor_text:
The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it
the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.

name: Necrozma
flavor_text: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

name: Cubone
flavor_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Timburr
flavor_text: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

name: Gurdurr
flavor_text: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor_text: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.

name: Crabrawler
flavor_text: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

name: Mudbray
flavor_text: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won't dry out even if it's exposed to the sun for a long time.

name: Mudsdale
flavor_text: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

name: Minior
flavor_text: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavor_text: It shows no interest in anything that isn't fresh. If you take it shopping with you, it will help you pick out ingredients.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavor_text: It has an incredibly greedy personality. Its nest is filled with so much food gathered by Rattata at its direction, it can't possibly eat it all.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavor_text: It's accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it's very picky about food.

name: Alolan Persian
flavor_text: The round face of Alolan Persian is considered to be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region, so these Pokémon are very well cared for.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavor_text: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Mareanie
flavor_text: This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for food. It often gets electric shocks from broken Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.

name: Toxapex
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavor_text: The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
flavor_text: Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create a sort of protective helmet on their heads, and they also function as highly precise sensors.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: Once it absorbs a key's metal ions, it discards the key without a second thought. However, it will hang on to keys it favors for decades.

name: Magearna
flavor_text: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Jangmo-o
flavor_text: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Hakamo-o
flavor_text: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

name: Kommo-o
flavor_text: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

name: Pikipek
flavor_text: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

name: Trumbeak
flavor_text: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.

name: Toucannon
flavor_text: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

name: Yungoos
flavor_text: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

name: Gumshoos
flavor_text: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

name: Stufful
flavor_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Oranguru
flavor_text: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

name: Komala
flavor_text: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

name: Big Malasada
effect: Heal 10 damage and remove a random Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.

name: Fishing Net
effect: Put a random Basic {W} Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Rare Candy

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavor_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Morelull
flavor_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Tsareena
flavor_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavor_text: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavor_text: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

name: Turtonator
flavor_text: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text: After long years in the ever-snowcapped mountains of Alola, this Vulpix has gained power over ice.

name: Pyukumuku
flavor_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Tapu Fini
flavor_text: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Tapu Koko
flavor_text: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Cutiefly
flavor_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

name: Comfey
flavor_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Tapu Lele
flavor_text: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Cosmog
flavor_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Mudsdale
flavor_text: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

name: Minior
flavor_text: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

name: Magearna
flavor_text: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Pikipek
flavor_text: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Komala
flavor_text: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
flavor_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Staryu
flavor_text: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Cubone
flavor_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Petilil
flavor_text:
The leaves on its head grow right back even if
they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those
who eat them.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text:
The fragrance of the garland on its head has
a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very
difficult.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text:
It sends its feathers, which are as sharp
as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong,
so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text:
This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you
don't groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Decidueye
flavor_text:
It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at
opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss,
it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

name: Pheromosa
flavor_text:
A life-form that lives in another world, its body
is thin and supple, but it also possesses
great power.

name: Kartana
flavor_text:
This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin
as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Blacephalon
flavor_text:
It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the
explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Mantine
flavor_text:
If it builds up enough speed swimming, it
can jump out above the waves and glide
for over 300 feet.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text:
It won't attack while it's alone—not even if it
spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to
join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text:
As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo
will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling
toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

name: Shinx
flavor_text:
The extension and contraction of its muscles
generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavor_text:
Strong electricity courses through the tips of
its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting
in foes.

name: Luxray
flavor_text:
It can see clearly through walls to track down its
prey and seek its lost young.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text:
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear.
It can catch lightning with its mane and store
the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text:
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it
shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Emolga
flavor_text:
As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles
with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can
cause a lot of trouble.

name: Xurkitree
flavor_text:
Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently
a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text:
It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents
apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack,
they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text:
It is said that happiness will come to those who
see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a
full moon.

name: Clefable
flavor_text:
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will
run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Phantump
flavor_text:
With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to
lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost
among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text:
People fear it due to a belief that it devours any
who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the
Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

name: Morelull
flavor_text:
It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone
seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
flavor_text:
Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to
sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing,
it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Meditite
flavor_text:
It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens
its inner strength through meditation.

name: Medicham
flavor_text:
Through yoga training, it gained the psychic
power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text:
It moves while spinning around on its single foot.
Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on
their heads.

name: Claydol
flavor_text:
This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient
clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young.
Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures,
but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Passimian
flavor_text:
This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries.
It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls
without skill.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text:
If it loses its shovel, it will stick something
else—like a branch—in its head to make
do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
flavor_text:
The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon
into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped,
it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavor_text:
It's accustomed to luxury because it
used to live with Alolan royalty. As a
result, it's very picky about food.

name: Alolan Persian
flavor_text:
The round face of Alolan Persian is considered
to be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region,
so these Pokémon are very well cared for.

name: Sandile
flavor_text:
It submerges itself in sand and moves as if
swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies
from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text:
Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see
even in the dead of night. They live in groups of
a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text:
After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it
twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Nihilego
flavor_text:
A life-form from another world, it was dubbed
a UB and is thought to produce a
strong neurotoxin.

name: Poipole
flavor_text:
This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be
chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Naganadel
flavor_text:
It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid
inside its body. It is one of the organisms known
as UBs.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavor_text:
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's habitat
caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Aron
flavor_text:
It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks—
to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
flavor_text:
It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory
by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
flavor_text:
Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate
thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by
ramming into them horn first.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text:
It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging
to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text:
This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks,
and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb
the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Stakataka
flavor_text:
It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one
appears to be made up of many life-forms
stacked one on top of each other.

name: Lillipup
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious.
It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect
information about its surroundings.

name: Herdier
flavor_text:
Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon.
So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was
the first Pokémon to partner with people.

name: Stoutland
flavor_text:
These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans.
Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up
to people in about three days.

name: Stufful
flavor_text:
Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out
to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavor_text:
Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show
its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is
dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Oranguru
flavor_text:
It normally spends its time meditating in the
treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other
Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Type: Null
flavor_text:
A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific
mission, it went berserk during an experiment,
so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Silvally
flavor_text:
This is its form once it has awakened and
evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is
greatly increased.

name: Celesteela
flavor_text:
One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings
can be detected coming from both of its
huge arms.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text:
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly
stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text:
An ancient picture scroll shows that people
were captivated by its movement as it ran
through prairies.

name: Froakie
flavor_text:
It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back.
The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise
take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text:
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise
control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
flavor_text:
It creates throwing stars out of compressed water.
When it spins them and throws them at high speed,
these stars can split metal in two.

name: Jynx
flavor_text:
Its strange cries sound like human language.
There are some musicians who compose songs
for Jynx to sing.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text:
A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps
its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text:
The claws on its feet are well developed.
It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute
to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text:
When hunting, it skims the surface of water
at high speed to pick off unwary prey such
as Magikarp.

name: Aerodactyl
flavor_text:
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times.
Apparently even modern technology is incapable
of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

name: Nihilego
flavor_text:
A life-form from another world, it was dubbed
a UB and is thought to produce a
strong neurotoxin.

name: Tropius
flavor_text:
It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit
around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows
twice a year.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text:
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of
sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis
to produce clean air.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text:
Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down
fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in
the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavor_text:
Steenee spreads a sweet scent that
makes others feel invigorated. This same
scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is
said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if
someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Applin
flavor_text:
It grows by eating the flesh of an apple.
Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen
the apple's skin and prevent it from rotting.

name: Appletun
flavor_text:
It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat
small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its
sweet nectar.

name: Flareon
flavor_text:
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and
exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees
Fahrenheit.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text:
It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows
out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Litten
flavor_text:
If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't
open up to you. Even if you do grow close,
giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavor_text:
Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they've
grown close, but it's a powerful, sharp-clawed
Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Incineroar
flavor_text:
Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it
finds beating down unworthy opponents boring.
It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

name: Salandit
flavor_text:
It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow,
rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic
gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text:
Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with
poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring
movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text:
It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with
a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Glaceon
flavor_text:
It can control its body temperature at will.
This enables it to freeze the moisture in the
atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

name: Vanillite
flavor_text:
Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself
comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to
cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Vanillish
flavor_text:
By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body.
This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with
warm, sunny weather.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text:
When its anger reaches a breaking point, this
Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes
every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

name: Alomomola
flavor_text:
It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its
fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

name: Popplio
flavor_text:
The balloons it inflates with its nose grow
larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavor_text:
It gets excited when it sees a dance it
doesn't know. This hard worker practices
diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text:
It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted
by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Joltik
flavor_text:
Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon.
It's soaking up static electricity because it can't
produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text:
It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its
means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could
be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Espeon
flavor_text:
The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is
predicting its opponent's next move.

name: Woobat
flavor_text:
While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots
of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's
evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text:
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out.
Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a
little while.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text:
It eats its own weight in sugar every day.
If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes
incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text:
By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their
mental and physical condition. It's hoped that
this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Sylveon
flavor_text:
This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send
a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing
their hostility.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text:
This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by
sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides
itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Milcery
flavor_text:
This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling
particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavor_text:
When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them
to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Barboach
flavor_text:
Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in
muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

name: Whiscash
flavor_text:
It is extremely protective of its territory. If any
foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text:
In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop
with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text:
When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging
opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the
fur on its arms.

name: Carbink
flavor_text:
When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all
out by firing high-energy beams from the gems
embedded in its body.

name: Umbreon
flavor_text:
When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its
body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Sableye
flavor_text:
Materials from gems it has eaten float to the
surface of its body and can form an infinite
number of patterns among individuals.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text:
Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable
behavior come away with stinging scratches from
its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavor_text:
Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant
figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Mawile
flavor_text:
It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into
complacency, then bites with its huge,
relentless jaws.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text:
With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon
takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon.
It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Meltan
flavor_text:
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid
metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text:
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and
fall apart. The small shards left behind will
eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Dratini
flavor_text:
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger.
During this process, it is protected by a rapid
waterfall.

name: Dragonair
flavor_text:
They say that if it emits an aura from its whole
body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Drampa
flavor_text:
The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles
in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play
with the children living in the towns below.

name: Eevee
evolves_to: Espeon|Espeon ex|Flareon|Flareon ex|Glaceon|Glaceon ex|Jolteon|Jolteon ex|Leafeon|Leafeon ex|Sylveon|Sylveon ex|Umbreon|Umbreon ex|Vaporeon|Vaporeon ex
flavor_text:
Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to
adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Aipom
flavor_text:
As it did more and more with its tail, its hands
became clumsy. It makes its nest high in
the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text:
It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both
of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze,
that's proof it really likes you.

name: Chatot
flavor_text:
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them
into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't
attack it.

name: Audino
flavor_text:
This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers,
Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.

name: Minccino
flavor_text:
The way it brushes away grime with its tail
can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on
spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text:
Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads
over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust.
Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text:
It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no
berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles
into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

name: Greedent
flavor_text:
This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping
them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon that evolves from Eevee.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text:
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of
sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis
to produce clean air.

name: Flareon
flavor_text:
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and
exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees
Fahrenheit.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text:
It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with
a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Glaceon
flavor_text:
It can control its body temperature at will.
This enables it to freeze the moisture in the
atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text:
It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted
by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Espeon
flavor_text:
The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is
predicting its opponent's next move.

name: Sylveon
flavor_text:
This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send
a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing
their hostility.

name: Umbreon
flavor_text:
When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its
body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Eevee
evolves_to: Espeon|Espeon ex|Flareon|Flareon ex|Glaceon|Glaceon ex|Jolteon|Jolteon ex|Leafeon|Leafeon ex|Sylveon|Sylveon ex|Umbreon|Umbreon ex|Vaporeon|Vaporeon ex
flavor_text:
Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to
adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Hau
effect: During this turn, attacks used by your Decidueye ex, Incineroar ex, or Primarina ex do +30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Penny
effect: Look at a random Supporter card that's not Penny from your opponent's deck and shuffle it back into their deck. Use the effect of that card as the effect of this card.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text:
These Pokémon judge one another based on
pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make
for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Lapras
flavor_text:
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon,
it glides across the surface of the sea while
its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text:
It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden
jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavor_text:
The more energy it charges up, the faster
it gets. But this also makes it more likely
to explode.

name: Ralts
flavor_text:
The horns on its head provide a strong power
that enables it to sense people's emotions.

name: Kirlia
evolves_to: Gallade|Gallade ex|Gardevoir|Mega Gallade ex|Mega Gardevoir ex
flavor_text:
It has a psychic power that enables it to distort
the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir
flavor_text:
To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic
power to create a small black hole.

name: Ekans
flavor_text:
By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger
than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok
flavor_text:
The latest research has determined that there
are over 20 possible arrangements of the
patterns on its stomach.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text:
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves
as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire
situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Eevee Bag
effect:
Choose 1:

During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon that evolve from Eevee do +10 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon that evolves from Eevee.

name: Oddish
flavor_text:
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move.
It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavor_text:
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor.
The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance
of 1.25 miles.

name: Bellossom
flavor_text:
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals
rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Tangela
flavor_text:
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows
nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this
Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth
flavor_text:
Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it
pleases. Recent research has shown that these
arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

name: Scyther
flavor_text:
It slashes through grass with its sharp
scythes, moving too fast for the human
eye to track.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text:
These Pokémon judge one another based on
pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make
for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Chikorita
flavor_text:
A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its
head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Bayleef
flavor_text:
A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck.
The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Meganium
flavor_text:
The aroma that rises from its petals contains a
substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: Ledyba
flavor_text:
These very cowardly Pokémon join together and
use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
flavor_text:
It's said that the patterns on its back are
related to the stars in the night sky, but the
details of that relationship remain unclear.

name: Hoppip
flavor_text:
Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found
practically everywhere. This is because the wind
carries this species all over the world.

name: Skiploom
flavor_text:
Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a
Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the
flower on the Pokémon's head.

name: Jumpluff
flavor_text:
Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its
cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does
its life.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text:
It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning.
Knowing it's weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

name: Sunflora
flavor_text:
In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic
manner, but it comes to a complete stop when
the sun sets.

name: Yanma
flavor_text:
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its
head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text:
It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads
instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Pineco
flavor_text:
It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it
from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

name: Heracross
flavor_text:
It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to
itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text:
It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked
by bird Pokémon that would love to make off
with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim
flavor_text:
After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes
this form. It's full of energy while it's like this,
and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text:
While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it
grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text:
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails
is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text:
It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball.
If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Quilava
flavor_text:
Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to
demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

name: Typhlosion
flavor_text:
If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything
that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: Slugma
flavor_text:
A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers
around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text:
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames
that circulate throughout its body.

name: Magby
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is still small and timid.
Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised,
flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

name: Entei
flavor_text:
A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said
that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text:
It derives its power from fire burning inside
its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will
immediately fall asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text:
The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon
can deliver punches capable of obliterating a
dump truck.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text:
There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in
the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the
hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text:
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking.
The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of
the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text:
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness.
This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of
lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Politoed
flavor_text:
At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores
of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by
letting out cries that sound like shouting.

name: Horsea
flavor_text:
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle
currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits
out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
flavor_text:
It's the males that raise the offspring. While
Seadra are raising young, the spines on their
backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text:
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may
jump high on rare occasions but never more
than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text:
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage.
It remains enraged until it demolishes
everything around it.

name: Totodile
flavor_text:
It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to
take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavor_text:
If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its
place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text:
It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding
speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Marill
flavor_text:
The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can
stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text:
Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish
the movements of things in water and tell what
they are.

name: Wooper
flavor_text:
This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the
water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavor_text:
It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it
bumps its head on boats and boulders
while swimming.

name: Qwilfish
flavor_text:
Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in
water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic
spikes that grow all over its body.

name: Corsola
flavor_text:
It will regrow any branches that break off its
head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola
branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text:
The water they shoot from their mouths can hit
moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavor_text:
Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals
the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Delibird
flavor_text:
It carries food all day long. There are tales about
lost people who were saved by the food it had.

name: Mantine
flavor_text:
While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores
Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

name: Suicune
flavor_text:
It races around the world to purify fouled water.
It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Corphish
flavor_text:
No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will
adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

name: Crawdaunt
flavor_text:
A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws.
It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text:
When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water,
escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
flavor_text:
Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap
their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text:
Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both
positive and negative charges flowing through them.

name: Pichu
flavor_text:
It is unskilled at storing electric power.
Any kind of shock causes it to discharge
energy spontaneously.

name: Mareep
flavor_text:
If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece
doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text:
As a result of storing too much electricity,
it developed patches where even downy
wool won't grow.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text:
The bright light on its tail can be seen far
away. It has been treasured since ancient
times as a beacon.

name: Elekid
flavor_text:
When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets
restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder,
it gets full-on rowdy.

name: Raikou
flavor_text:
The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts
at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Emolga
flavor_text:
As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles
with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can
cause a lot of trouble.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text:
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five
seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowking
flavor_text:
When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's
head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Smoochum
flavor_text:
If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will
bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty,
Smoochum doesn't really seem to care.

name: Jynx
flavor_text:
Its strange cries sound like human language.
There are some musicians who compose songs
for Jynx to sing.

name: Cleffa
flavor_text:
According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen
in places where shooting stars have fallen.

name: Togepi
flavor_text:
The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said
that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavor_text:
They say that it will appear before kindhearted,
caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text:
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near
conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly
been seen at all.

name: Natu
flavor_text:
It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and
likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu
flavor_text:
They say that it stays still and quiet because it is
seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Unown
flavor_text:
Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape
appears to have some meaning.

name: Unown
flavor_text:
Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape
appears to have some meaning.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text:
It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its
body to pump up its counterstrike.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text:
Girafarig's tail has a small head. It instinctively
bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon
from behind.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text:
It grows close to others easily and is also easily
spoiled. The disparity between its face and its
actions makes many young people wild about it.

name: Granbull
flavor_text:
While it has powerful jaws, it doesn't care for
disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display
their might.

name: Munna
flavor_text:
Late at night, it appears beside people's pillows.
As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body
give off a faint glow.

name: Musharna
flavor_text:
When dark mists emanate from its body, don't
get too near. If you do, your nightmares will
become reality.

name: Onix
flavor_text:
As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many
hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text:
Although it always pretends to be a tree,
its composition appears more similar to
rock than to vegetation.

name: Gligar
flavor_text:
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey,
it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text:
It observes prey while hanging inverted from
branches. When the chance presents itself,
it swoops!

name: Swinub
flavor_text:
It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up
food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Piloswine
flavor_text:
If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back
stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Mamoswine
flavor_text:
This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings
from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a
while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text:
This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank.
After playing in the mud, it won't be able to
settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Tyrogue
flavor_text:
It is always bursting with energy. To make itself
stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text:
It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high
speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text:
Born deep underground, this Pokémon
becomes a pupa after eating enough
dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar
flavor_text:
This pupa flies around wildly by venting with
great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

name: Binacle
flavor_text:
After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they
adhere themselves to it and live together.
They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavor_text:
Seven Binacle come together to form one
Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head
gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Zubat
flavor_text:
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check
its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies
around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavor_text:
It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said
that if it finds others of its kind going hungry,
it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text:
It lies still in the same pose for days in its web,
waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: Ariados
flavor_text:
Every night, it wanders around in search of
prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing
threads before it bites into them with its fangs.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text:
Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to
bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text:
It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never
forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text:
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of
darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Weavile
flavor_text:
Evolution made it even more devious.
It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Houndour
flavor_text:
It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a
variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text:
If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its
mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text:
Extremely strong, it can change the landscape.
It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

name: Absol
flavor_text:
Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and
mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely
sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Forretress
flavor_text:
It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters
pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Steelix
flavor_text:
It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years,
its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Scizor
flavor_text:
This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can
crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

name: Mawile
flavor_text:
It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into
complacency, then bites with its huge,
relentless jaws.

name: Klink
flavor_text:
The two minigears that compose this Pokémon
are closer than twins. They mesh well only with
each other.

name: Klang
flavor_text:
When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up
perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and
this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text:
From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of
electricity. Its red core contains an enormous
amount of energy.

name: Spearow
flavor_text:
Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to
others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect
its territory.

name: Fearow
flavor_text:
Carrying food through Fearow's territory is
dangerous. It will snatch the food away from
you in a flash!

name: Chansey
flavor_text:
This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs
and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Blissey
flavor_text:
Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's
egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant
to everyone.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text:
Although it's carrying its baby in a pouch on
its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It
intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

name: Eevee
evolves_to: Espeon|Espeon ex|Flareon|Flareon ex|Glaceon|Glaceon ex|Jolteon|Jolteon ex|Leafeon|Leafeon ex|Sylveon|Sylveon ex|Umbreon|Umbreon ex|Vaporeon|Vaporeon ex
flavor_text:
Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to
adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Porygon
flavor_text:
State-of-the-art technology was used to create
Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be
created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2
flavor_text:
This is a Porygon that was updated with special
data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about
many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor_text:
Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to
move between dimensions, but the program also
caused instability in Porygon-Z's behavior.

name: Sentret
flavor_text:
When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger
by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

name: Furret
flavor_text:
The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up
around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text:
It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so
fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text:
Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to
see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Aipom
flavor_text:
As it did more and more with its tail, its hands
became clumsy. It makes its nest high in
the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text:
It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both
of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze,
that's proof it really likes you.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text:
It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted,
it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text:
Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When
nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon
have a smile back on its face.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text:
It usually wears a hardened expression, but when
it's licking up honey—which it loves—the joy it
feels will cause it to break into a wide grin.

name: Stantler
flavor_text:
This Pokémon apparently used to live in much
harsher environments, and thus it once had
stronger psychic powers than it does now.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text:
The fluid of Smeargle's tail secretions changes
in the intensity of its hue as the Pokémon's
emotions change.

name: Bouffalant
flavor_text:
These Pokémon can crush a car with no more
than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on
their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

name: Chikorita
flavor_text:
A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its
head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Bellossom
flavor_text:
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals
rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Heracross
flavor_text:
It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to
itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text:
It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball.
If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Magby
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is still small and timid.
Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised,
flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

name: Totodile
flavor_text:
It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to
take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Qwilfish
flavor_text:
Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in
water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic
spikes that grow all over its body.

name: Octillery
flavor_text:
Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals
the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Delibird
flavor_text:
It carries food all day long. There are tales about
lost people who were saved by the food it had.

name: Pichu
flavor_text:
It is unskilled at storing electric power.
Any kind of shock causes it to discharge
energy spontaneously.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text:
The bright light on its tail can be seen far
away. It has been treasured since ancient
times as a beacon.

name: Togepi
flavor_text:
The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said
that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Xatu
flavor_text:
They say that it stays still and quiet because it is
seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text:
It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its
body to pump up its counterstrike.

name: Gligar
flavor_text:
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey,
it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text:
It lies still in the same pose for days in its web,
waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text:
Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to
bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text:
Extremely strong, it can change the landscape.
It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

name: Scizor
flavor_text:
This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can
crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

name: Sentret
flavor_text:
When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger
by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text:
It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so
fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Stantler
flavor_text:
This Pokémon apparently used to live in much
harsher environments, and thus it once had
stronger psychic powers than it does now.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text:
The fluid of Smeargle's tail secretions changes
in the intensity of its hue as the Pokémon's
emotions change.

name: Blissey
flavor_text:
Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's
egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant
to everyone.
