name: Yanma
flavor_text:
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its
head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Flareon
flavor_text:
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated,
and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000
degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text:
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may
jump high on rare occasions but never more
than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text:
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage.
It remains enraged until it demolishes
everything around it.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text:
It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with
a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text:
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units
at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which
allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavor_text:
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic
force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text:
It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted
by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text:
This Pokémon startles people in the middle of
the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Mankey
flavor_text:
It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of
its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape
flavor_text:
It becomes wildly furious if it even senses
someone looking at it. It chases anyone
that meets its glare.

name: Nidoran♀
flavor_text:
Females are more sensitive to smells than males.
While foraging, they'll use their whiskers to check
wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text:
The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought
that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get
poked while their mother is feeding them.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text:
Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense.
With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield
its children from any kind of attack.

name: Nidoran♂
flavor_text:
The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead contains
a powerful poison. This is a very cautious
Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text:
With a horn that's harder than diamond, this
Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it
searches for a moon stone.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text:
When it goes on a rampage, it's impossible to
control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it's
lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text:
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of
darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text:
If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and
you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in.
The itch won't go away, either.

name: Eevee
evolves_to: Espeon|Espeon ex|Flareon|Flareon ex|Glaceon|Glaceon ex|Jolteon|Jolteon ex|Leafeon|Leafeon ex|Sylveon|Sylveon ex|Umbreon|Umbreon ex|Vaporeon|Vaporeon ex
flavor_text:
Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to
adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Hoppip
flavor_text:
Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found
practically everywhere. This is because the wind
carries this species all over the world.

name: Skiploom
flavor_text:
Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a
Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the
flower on the Pokémon's head.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text:
It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning.
Knowing it's weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

name: Sunflora
flavor_text:
In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic
manner, but it comes to a complete stop when
the sun sets.

name: Celebi
flavor_text:
This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees
flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Durant
flavor_text:
They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel
armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Slugma
flavor_text:
A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers
around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text:
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames
that circulate throughout its body.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text:
Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass
where bug Pokémon might be hiding and
then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text:
It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies
around easily, even while carrying prey
that weighs more than 220 lbs.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text:
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking.
The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of
the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text:
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness.
This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of
lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text:
Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer.
It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it
searches for prey.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text:
When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head glow
brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to
fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text:
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five
seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowking
flavor_text:
When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's
head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Jynx
flavor_text:
Its strange cries sound like human language.
There are some musicians who compose songs
for Jynx to sing.

name: Feebas
flavor_text:
Although unattractive and unpopular, this
Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a
subject of research.

name: Milotic
flavor_text:
Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists.
It has even been referred to as the most
beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Mantyke
flavor_text:
It's highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that
take people swimming with Mantyke are a
super-popular beach activity.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text:
Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said
that people and Pokémon who die on snowy
mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text:
While one alone doesn't have much power,
a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful
as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text:
They coil around foes and shock them with
electricity-generating organs that seem simply
to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text:
They crawl out of the ocean using their arms.
They will attack prey on shore and immediately
drag it into the ocean.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text:
Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with
it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to
generate electricity.

name: Yamper
flavor_text:
This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with
their work because it wants treats. As it runs,
it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
flavor_text:
This Pokémon generates electricity and channels
it into its legs to keep them going strong.
Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text:
This Pokémon startles people in the middle of
the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text:
Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry
may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavor_text:
Watch your step when wandering areas oceans
once covered. What looks like a stone could be
this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

name: Galarian Cursola
flavor_text:
Its shell is overflowing with its heightened
otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as
protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

name: Latias
flavor_text:
It communicates using telepathy. Its body is
covered in down that refracts light to make
it invisible.

name: Latios
flavor_text:
It understands human speech and is highly
intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that
dislikes fighting.

name: Frillish
flavor_text:
It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws
it down to the deeps, five miles below the
ocean's surface.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text:
Most of this Pokémon's body composition is
identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships
its lair.

name: Diglett
flavor_text:
It lives about one yard underground, where it
feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears
aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text:
Its three heads bob separately up and down to
loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it
to burrow.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text:
This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank.
After playing in the mud, it won't be able to
settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Donphan
flavor_text:
Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being
hit by a car won't faze this Pokémon. However, it
is extremely susceptible to rain.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text:
Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders
allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water
pressure of the deep sea.

name: Dwebble
flavor_text:
It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock
breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it
locates a replacement.

name: Crustle
flavor_text:
This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry
climates. It won't come out of its boulder on
rainy days.

name: Seviper
flavor_text:
Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on
its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

name: Zorua
flavor_text:
It changes into the forms of others to surprise
them. Apparently, it often transforms into a
silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavor_text:
Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were
trapped in an illusion and punished.

name: Inkay
flavor_text:
It spins while making its luminescent spots flash.
These spots allow it to communicate with others
by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar
flavor_text:
Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly
induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer
under Malamar's control.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text:
Skrelp evades its enemies by hiding amid
drifting seaweed. It eats rotten seaweed to
create its poison.

name: Dragalge
flavor_text:
Using a liquid poison, Dragalge indiscriminately
attacks anything that wanders into its territory.
This poison can corrode the undersides of boats.

name: Altaria
flavor_text:
If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop
the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text:
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves
as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire
situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text:
If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and
you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in.
The itch won't go away, either.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text:
Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many
times the length of its body. No one has figured
out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

name: Igglybuff
flavor_text:
Its body has a faintly sweet scent and is bouncy
and soft. If it bounces even once, it cannot stop.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text:
Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When
nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon
have a smile back on its face.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text:
It usually wears a hardened expression, but when
it's licking up honey—which it loves—the joy it
feels will cause it to break into a wide grin.

name: Miltank
flavor_text:
Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's
been supporting the lives of people and other
Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Azurill
flavor_text:
Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail
around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

name: Swablu
flavor_text:
It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes
a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Zangoose
flavor_text:
It's Seviper's archrival. To threaten those
it encounters, it fans out the claws on its
front paws.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle,
its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text:
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly.
Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

name: Monferno
flavor_text:
It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its
tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text:
It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the
headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious
powers.

name: Golduck
flavor_text:
When it swims at full speed using its long,
webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins
to glow.

name: Krabby
flavor_text:
It can be found near the sea. The large pincers
grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler
flavor_text:
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower
strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy
to move.

name: Pyukumuku
flavor_text:
It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a
foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means
to punch them.

name: Gible
flavor_text:
It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy
passes by, it leaps out and chomps them.
The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Gabite
flavor_text:
In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales.
Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient
will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavor_text:
After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began
living on land. The Pokémon changed over time,
developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Mantyke
flavor_text:
It's highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that
take people swimming with Mantyke are a
super-popular beach activity.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text:
This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey
and then either splits the prey in half or flings
it away.

name: Wurmple
flavor_text:
It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels
attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Silcoon
flavor_text:
It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for
evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

name: Beautifly
flavor_text:
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its
long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

name: Cascoon
flavor_text:
It never forgets any attack it endured while in the
cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Dustox
flavor_text:
It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust
when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

name: Seedot
flavor_text:
It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of
its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text:
They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound
of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text:
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to
create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text:
If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top
of its head to protect itself.

name: Breloom
flavor_text:
The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores.
It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible
punches.

name: Pansage
flavor_text:
It's good at finding berries and gathers them from
all over. It's kind enough to share them
with friends.

name: Simisage
flavor_text:
Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail
around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is
very bitter.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text:
It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself.
If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds,
it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Petilil
flavor_text:
If the leaves on its head are pruned with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into
a fine plump shape.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text:
No matter how much time and money is spent
raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when
they bloom in the wild.

name: Maractus
flavor_text:
Arid regions are their habitat. They move
rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Virizion
flavor_text:
It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick
movements, slicing them up with its horns.

name: Skiddo
flavor_text:
As long as it has sunlight and water, Skiddo can
make energy with the leaves on its body, allowing
it to live on rocky mountains barren of food.

name: Gogoat
flavor_text:
These Pokémon live in herds in mountainous
places. The victor in their contests of clashing
horns will become the leader of the herd.

name: Phantump
flavor_text:
With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to
lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost
among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text:
Small roots that extend from the tips of this
Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the
forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Grookey
flavor_text:
It attacks with rapid beats of its stick.
As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets
more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
flavor_text:
When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it
gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even
notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

name: Rillaboom
flavor_text:
The one with the best drumming techniques
becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle
disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text:
It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try
to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text:
Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty.
Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text:
If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning
mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Ho-Oh
flavor_text:
It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by
shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

name: Torchic
flavor_text:
A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug.
It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Combusken
flavor_text:
During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases.
Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Blaziken
flavor_text:
When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from
its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear
over buildings.

name: Pansear
flavor_text:
This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes.
The fire within the tuft on its head can reach
600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
flavor_text:
When it gets excited, embers rise from its head
and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it
loves sweets.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text:
This popular symbol of good fortune will never
fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed
or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text:
This Pokémon's power level rises along with the
temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500
degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litwick
flavor_text:
The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs,
the brighter and eerier the flame on its
head burns.

name: Lampent
flavor_text:
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp.
Once it finds someone whose death is near,
it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text:
In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of
lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—
or so it's said.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text:
A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the
hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour
their insides.

name: Litleo
flavor_text:
The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by
battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane
will grow.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text:
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to over
3,600 degrees Fahrenheit during battle. Merely
approaching it will cause severe burns.

name: Turtonator
flavor_text:
Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes
explosive compounds to develop in its shell.
Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text:
If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit
odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an
episode.

name: Golduck
flavor_text:
It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow-
moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text:
In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than
the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text:
It appears whenever there is world conflict,
burning down any place it travels through.

name: Lotad
flavor_text:
Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land.
That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Lombre
flavor_text:
It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny.
It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and
becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo
flavor_text:
If it hears festive music, it begins moving in
rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text:
When it sucks in a large volume of seawater,
it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton
of food daily.

name: Wailord
flavor_text:
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth
of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Corphish
flavor_text:
It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped
to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Crawdaunt
flavor_text:
A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will
crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Luvdisc
flavor_text:
During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc
congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

name: Panpour
flavor_text:
The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of
nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavor_text:
It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs
low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with
its tail.

name: Tympole
flavor_text:
It uses sound waves to communicate with
others of its kind. People and other Pokémon
species can't hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text:
On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to
the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their
bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is popular among the elderly,
who say the vibrations of its lumps are great
for massages.

name: Tirtouga
flavor_text:
Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of
many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life
from a fossil.

name: Carracosta
flavor_text:
This Pokémon emerges from the water in search
of prey despite the fact that it moves more
slowly on land.

name: Frillish
flavor_text:
Legend has it that the residents of a sunken
ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text:
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky,
schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of
the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text:
It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of
oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Froakie
flavor_text:
It protects its skin by covering its body in
delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air,
it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text:
Its swiftness is unparalleled.
It can scale a tower of more
than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Bergmite
flavor_text:
They live in mountainous regions of frigid cold.
On rare occasions, they ride on the back of an
Avalugg to cross seas and move to new habitats.

name: Avalugg
flavor_text:
This Pokémon uses its massive icy body to flatten
anything that gets in its way. When it's floating
out on the ocean, it looks exactly like drift ice.

name: Chewtle
flavor_text:
A popular game among children is to lift up sticks
that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose
Chewtle can hang on the longest.

name: Drednaw
flavor_text:
Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey
come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck
out and chomps down on them.

name: Arrokuda
flavor_text:
It takes down prey by charging into them with
its hard, pointed jaw. But Arrokuda's eyesight is
poor, so this tactic has a low success rate.

name: Barraskewda
flavor_text:
It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging
forward at speeds of over 100 knots before
ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Eiscue
flavor_text:
If you lick the ice covering its face, you'll find it
has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on
ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.

name: Mareep
flavor_text:
Its fleece grows continually. In the summer,
the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in
a week.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text:
Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin,
it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text:
When it gets dark, the light from its bright,
shiny tail can be seen from far away on the
ocean's surface.

name: Shinx
flavor_text:
The extension and contraction of its muscles
generates electricity. Its fur glows when it's
in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavor_text:
By gathering their tails together, they collectively
generate powerful electricity from their claws.

name: Luxray
flavor_text:
Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in
handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text:
A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches
together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text:
Its mane shines when it discharges electricity.
They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes
to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text:
They have lightning-like movements.
When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of
thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik
flavor_text:
Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon.
It's soaking up static electricity because it can't
produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text:
It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests
of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are
not yet good at flying.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text:
Dedenne emit electrical waves from the whiskers
on their cheeks to communicate with each other.
When low on electricity, they curl up and sleep.

name: Yamper
flavor_text:
This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with
their work because it wants treats. As it runs,
it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
flavor_text:
It sends electricity through its legs to boost their
strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks
50 mph.

name: Natu
flavor_text:
Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to
hop to get around. It is always staring
at something.

name: Xatu
flavor_text:
This odd Pokémon can see both the past and
the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text:
It loves to bite and yank people's hair from
behind without warning, just to see their
shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text:
Its cries sound like incantations to torment the
foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Sableye
flavor_text:
Materials from gems it has eaten float to the
surface of its body and can form an infinite
number of patterns among individuals.

name: Duskull
flavor_text:
Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to
prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text:
It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them
into its empty body. What happens inside is
a mystery.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text:
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir swallows its
target whole. The soul is the only thing eaten—
Dusknoir disgorges the body before departing.

name: Jirachi
flavor_text:
It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for
just one week every thousand years.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text:
Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old
folktale calls it a "signpost for wandering spirits."

name: Drifblim
flavor_text:
They carry people and Pokémon, but the
wind can catch them, so there can't be a
fixed destination.

name: Chingling
flavor_text:
There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops,
the orb bounces all over and makes a
ringing sound.

name: Yamask
flavor_text:
The spirit of a person from a bygone age became
this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching
for someone who knows its face.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text:
There are many depictions of Cofagrigus
decorating ancient tombs. They're symbols
of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Gothita
flavor_text:
Beware of touching the ribbon-shaped feelers
that control its psychic power. Gothita will begin
bawling if you do.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text:
Using its psychic power, it arranges pebbles to
form the shapes of constellations. Some people
believe this Pokémon came from outer space.

name: Gothitelle
flavor_text:
It gazes at the stars to predict the future. It acts
somewhat detached because it has seen the end
of all existence.

name: Spritzee
flavor_text:
The scent its body gives off enraptures those
who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of
love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse
flavor_text:
The scents Aromatisse can produce range from
sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells
that sap an opponent's will to fight.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text:
The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes
Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out
sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text:
Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft
to the touch and lighter than it looks.

name: Carbink
flavor_text:
It's said that somewhere in the world, there's
a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering
Carbink. It's also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Klefki
flavor_text:
In the past, noble families entrusted their vault
keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down
through the generations, taking good care of it.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text:
It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If
hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp
claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text:
It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws.
Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping
them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text:
To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but
mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text:
It toughens up by slamming into thick trees
over and over. It gains a sturdy body and
dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text:
It stomps on the ground to build power.
It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a
straight-arm punch.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text:
It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs.
It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text:
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of
fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of
sand while attacking.

name: Sandile
flavor_text:
They live hidden under hot desert sands in order
to keep their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text:
Thanks to the special membrane covering its
eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in
the middle of the night.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text:
Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey
more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of
a sandstorm.

name: Archen
flavor_text:
Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird
Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries
and bug Pokémon.

name: Archeops
flavor_text:
Though capable of flight, Archeops was
apparently better at hunting on the ground.

name: Golett
flavor_text:
This Pokémon was created from clay. It received
orders from its master many thousands of years
ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golurk
flavor_text:
There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual
motion machine that produces limitless energy,
but this belief hasn't been proven.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text:
It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush
anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Pancham
flavor_text:
Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously,
Pancham's always giving others a glare.
But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Crabrawler
flavor_text:
If it loses its pincers, they'll quickly regrow.
The pincers are popular ingredients in paella
since their shells produce a tasty soup stock.

name: Crabominable
flavor_text:
Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon's
movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles
from its mouth to immobilize its opponents.

name: Stufful
flavor_text:
The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may
be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is
flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
flavor_text:
The moves it uses to take down its prey would
make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued
prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text:
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to
close in on them while they're blinded, but since
Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

name: Palossand
flavor_text:
From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones
of its victims, which are all dried up after being
drained of their vitality.

name: Rolycoly
flavor_text:
Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon's body
that have grown old and flaked off have long
been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

name: Carkol
flavor_text:
Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of
coal on Carkol's back never falls apart, even
when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Coalossal
flavor_text:
It's gentle usually but fearsome when angered.
With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees
Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text:
If spotted, it will lure an unwary person
into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on
mountain trails.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text:
A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and
more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will
assemble.

name: Absol
flavor_text:
Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect
danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer
of doom.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text:
It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked
in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this
Pokémon's poison seeps in.

name: Drapion
flavor_text:
It's so vicious that it's called the Sand Demon.
Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion
keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

name: Darkrai
flavor_text:
It can lull people to sleep and make them dream.
It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Deino
flavor_text:
It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce,
so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that
moves and attempt to eat it.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text:
The two heads have different likes and dislikes.
Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous
gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text:
It's said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because
people in times long past loathed it, considering
it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text:
Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of
its opponents. It strikes with punches that can
turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is a poor swimmer. If it's caught in
a fierce storm, it will sometimes get washed far
away and become unable to return to its home.

name: Mareanie
flavor_text:
It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs
that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter,
astringent flavor—they're not suitable as food.

name: Toxapex
flavor_text:
Toxapex gets into fierce battles with Bruxish over
areas where warm ocean currents flow, but the
odds are always against it.

name: Impidimp
flavor_text:
They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks
on each other to polish their troublemaking skills.

name: Morgrem
flavor_text:
This Pokémon absorbs negative emotions and
turns them into energy. It's popular with people
who tend to think gloomy thoughts.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavor_text:
It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving
into this splendid form, it hasn't given up on its
petty misdeeds and pranks.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text:
Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings.
Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's
spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text:
Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon
crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes
on its feelers into the stone.

name: Durant
flavor_text:
They lay their eggs deep inside their nests.
When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate
using their massive mandibles.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text:
It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its
allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Honedge
flavor_text:
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the
true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it
drains people's lives away.

name: Doublade
flavor_text:
The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly
alternating between offense and defense to
bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text:
Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash
reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually
drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Meltan
flavor_text:
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid
metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Corviknight
flavor_text:
Although its wings have partly turned to steel and
become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies
through the skies with ease.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text:
Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up
residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon,
treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Goomy
flavor_text:
Goomy's horns are excellent sensory organs that
cover all five of Goomy's senses. Goomy picks
up on danger from the movement of the air.

name: Sliggoo
flavor_text:
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus coating
its entire body becomes more concentrated—
it'll dissolve anything.

name: Goodra
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is uncontrollable when enraged.
It rampages on and on, lashing its tail with
enough power to send a dump truck flying.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text:
It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict.
If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text:
Very protective of its sprawling territorial area,
this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text:
It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate
enemies. It races through the skies at
Mach-2 speed.

name: Eevee
evolves_to: Espeon|Espeon ex|Flareon|Flareon ex|Glaceon|Glaceon ex|Jolteon|Jolteon ex|Leafeon|Leafeon ex|Sylveon|Sylveon ex|Umbreon|Umbreon ex|Vaporeon|Vaporeon ex
flavor_text:
Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is
exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Aipom
flavor_text:
It searches for prey from the tops of trees.
When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet,
Aipom gets excited and pounces.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text:
It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both
of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze,
that's proof it really likes you.

name: Miltank
flavor_text:
This Pokémon needs to be milked every day,
or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk
changes with the seasons.

name: Zigzagoon
flavor_text:
A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an
interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Linoone
flavor_text:
It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws
to bring down prey. Running along winding
paths is not its strong suit.

name: Whismur
flavor_text:
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice
startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder.
It cries until it's exhausted, then it falls asleep.

name: Loudred
flavor_text:
The force of this Pokémon's loud voice isn't just
the sound—it's also the wave of air pressure that
blows opponents away and damages them.

name: Exploud
flavor_text:
This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To
communicate with others of its kind, it'll emit all
sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

name: Skitty
flavor_text:
It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail
until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text:
It is highly popular among female Trainers for its
sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Spinda
flavor_text:
Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its
stumbling movements, it evades opponents'
attacks brilliantly!

name: Swablu
flavor_text:
It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean.
It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Altaria
flavor_text:
On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and
blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful
soprano.

name: Chatot
flavor_text:
It can learn and speak human words. If they gather,
they all learn the same saying.

name: Patrat
flavor_text:
Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on
the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming
from behind.

name: Watchog
flavor_text:
When they see an enemy, their tails stand high,
and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their
cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is far brighter than the average
child, and Lillipup won't forget the love it
receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Herdier
flavor_text:
The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body
is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce
right off.

name: Stoutland
flavor_text:
Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive
moustache. It's said that moustache length is what
determines social standing among this species.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text:
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its
prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also
consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

name: Braviary
flavor_text:
For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of
the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Rookidee
flavor_text:
The females are fussier than the males. If another
creature dirties a female Rookidee's wings, it'll
peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

name: Corvisquire
flavor_text:
This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to
use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

name: Wooloo
flavor_text:
If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be
able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this
Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool
flavor_text:
Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the
opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Beautifly
flavor_text:
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its
long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

name: Skiddo
flavor_text:
As long as it has sunlight and water, Skiddo can
make energy with the leaves on its body, allowing
it to live on rocky mountains barren of food.

name: Rillaboom
flavor_text:
The one with the best drumming techniques
becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle
disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text:
It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try
to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text:
In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of
lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—
or so it's said.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text:
In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than
the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Ludicolo
flavor_text:
If it hears festive music, it begins moving in
rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text:
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky,
schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of
the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text:
It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of
oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Eiscue
flavor_text:
If you lick the ice covering its face, you'll find it
has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on
ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.

name: Luxray
flavor_text:
Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in
handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text:
There are many depictions of Cofagrigus
decorating ancient tombs. They're symbols
of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

name: Gothita
flavor_text:
Beware of touching the ribbon-shaped feelers
that control its psychic power. Gothita will begin
bawling if you do.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text:
It toughens up by slamming into thick trees
over and over. It gains a sturdy body and
dauntless spirit.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text:
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of
fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of
sand while attacking.

name: Archeops
flavor_text:
Though capable of flight, Archeops was
apparently better at hunting on the ground.

name: Pancham
flavor_text:
Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously,
Pancham's always giving others a glare.
But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text:
A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and
more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will
assemble.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text:
It's said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because
people in times long past loathed it, considering
it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

name: Corviknight
flavor_text:
Although its wings have partly turned to steel and
become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies
through the skies with ease.

name: Goomy
flavor_text:
Goomy's horns are excellent sensory organs that
cover all five of Goomy's senses. Goomy picks
up on danger from the movement of the air.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text:
It is highly popular among female Trainers for its
sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Stoutland
flavor_text:
Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive
moustache. It's said that moustache length is what
determines social standing among this species.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text:
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its
prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also
consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text:
Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is
blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text:
The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes.
It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text:
Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles,
although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text:
It sends its feathers, which are as sharp
as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong,
so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text:
This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you
don't groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Moltres
flavor_text:
It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When
Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with
a dazzling red glow.

name: Litten
flavor_text:
If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't
open up to you. Even if you do grow close,
giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavor_text:
Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they've
grown close, but it's a powerful, sharp-clawed
Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text:
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking.
The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of
the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text:
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness.
This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of
lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text:
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through
cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to
smash through drift ice and plow forward.

name: Articuno
flavor_text:
It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings
are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy
mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text:
It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond
with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Popplio
flavor_text:
The balloons it inflates with its nose grow
larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavor_text:
It gets excited when it sees a dance it
doesn't know. This hard worker practices
diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text:
This Pokémon has complete control over
electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in
the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text:
This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar.
It uses nimble steps to approach opponents,
then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text:
It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents
apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack,
they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text:
It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats
the dreams of adults because children's are much
tastier.

name: Hypno
flavor_text:
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use
a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and
Confusion.

name: Geodude
flavor_text:
Geodude that have lived a long life have had all
their edges smoothed out until they're totally
round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavor_text:
It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak
of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit,
it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem
flavor_text:
When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their
shells. Those that have lived a long, long time
have shells green with moss.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young.
Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures,
but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavor_text:
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's habitat
caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Meowth
flavor_text:
All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night,
it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Persian
flavor_text:
Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to
raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Doduo
flavor_text:
A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a
sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles
per hour.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text:
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the
three heads—even for a second—will get
pecked severely.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text:
With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is
more agile and active than it appears.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text:
No matter how much time and money is spent
raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when
they bloom in the wild.

name: Klefki
flavor_text:
In the past, noble families entrusted their vault
keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down
through the generations, taking good care of it.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text:
While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are
stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text:
The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more
strength wells up within it, allowing the bud
on its back to grow larger.

name: Venusaur
flavor_text:
A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.
The fragrance becalms those engaged
in a battle.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text:
Although the poison from its fangs isn't that
strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that
gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavor_text:
It spews threads from its mouth to catch its
prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go
hunt aggressively.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text:
It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to
shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

name: Sunflora
flavor_text:
Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always
looking in the direction of the sun.

name: Burmy
flavor_text:
If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes
the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Mothim
flavor_text:
It flutters around at night and steals honey from
the Combee hive.

name: Charmander
flavor_text:
From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip
of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to
go out.

name: Charmeleon
evolves_to: Charizard|Charizard ex|Mega Charizard X ex|Mega Charizard Y ex
flavor_text:
If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts
intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Charizard
flavor_text:
Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an
altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very
high temperatures.

name: Houndour
flavor_text:
It uses different kinds of cries for communicating
with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text:
Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get
the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text:
When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside
its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text:
It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to
maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text:
The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water
capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Basculin
flavor_text:
Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on
the hook. And there are always more to catch—
many people release them into lakes illicitly.

name: Clauncher
flavor_text:
Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off.
The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a
distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

name: Clawitzer
flavor_text:
The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer
launches from its claw are powerful enough to
punch through tanker hulls.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text:
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units
at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which
allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavor_text:
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic
force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text:
Exposure to a special magnetic field changed
Magneton's molecular structure, turning it into
Magnezone.

name: Emolga
flavor_text:
This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries.
Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much
food that it can't fly properly.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text:
The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity
generation. Interruption of that process
stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text:
One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill
outspread is all it would take to produce enough
electricity to power a city.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text:
It loves to bite and yank people's hair from
behind without warning, just to see their
shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text:
Its cries sound like incantations to torment the
foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Solosis
flavor_text:
Many say that the special liquid covering this
Pokémon's body would allow it to survive in
the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
flavor_text:
Its brain has split into two, and the two
halves rarely think alike. Its actions are
utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text:
It's said that drinking the liquid surrounding
Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is
highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Spritzee
flavor_text:
The scent its body gives off enraptures those
who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of
love for Spritzee.

name: Aromatisse
flavor_text:
The scents Aromatisse can produce range from
sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells
that sap an opponent's will to fight.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text:
When the horns on its head shine
in seven colors, it is said to be
sharing everlasting life.

name: Onix
flavor_text:
It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by
squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text:
It toughens up by slamming into thick trees
over and over. It gains a sturdy body and
dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text:
It stomps on the ground to build power.
It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a
straight-arm punch.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text:
The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an
unerring compass, making it an excellent
partner for Trainers going on a journey.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text:
Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce.
Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly
will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text:
Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this
Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into
tiny pieces.

name: Grimer
flavor_text:
Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up
polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Muk
flavor_text:
They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge
accumulates, making the stench around
them worse.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text:
Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable
behavior come away with stinging scratches from
its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavor_text:
Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant
figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text:
Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you
leave trash lying around, you could even find
one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text:
This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison
inside its body. The main component of the
poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Steelix
flavor_text:
It is thought its body transformed as a result of
iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Probopass
flavor_text:
It exudes strong magnetism from all over.
It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

name: Genesect
flavor_text:
This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team
Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Ditto
flavor_text:
It can freely recombine its own cellular structure
to transform into other life-forms.

name: Porygon
flavor_text:
State-of-the-art technology was used to create
Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be
created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2
flavor_text:
This is a Porygon that was updated with special
data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about
many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor_text:
Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to
move between dimensions, but the program also
caused instability in Porygon-Z's behavior.

name: Starly
flavor_text:
Because they are weak individually, they form
groups. However, they bicker if the group grows
too big.

name: Staravia
flavor_text:
They maintain huge flocks, although fierce
scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text:
It never stops attacking even if it is injured.
It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Buneary
flavor_text:
Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and
then striking with the force created by unrolling
them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Lopunny
flavor_text:
Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny's coat will
be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating
air in preparation for colder weather.

name: Bouffalant
flavor_text:
These Pokémon live in herds of about 20
individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will
lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Oddish
flavor_text:
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move.
It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavor_text:
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor.
The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance
of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text:
It has the world's largest petals. With every step,
the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Charizard
flavor_text:
Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an
altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very
high temperatures.

name: Shellder
flavor_text:
It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond.
Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavor_text:
Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents
grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text:
It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If
hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp
claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text:
It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws.
Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping
them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Type: Null
flavor_text:
A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific
mission, it went berserk during an experiment,
so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Silvally
flavor_text:
This is its form once it has awakened and
evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is
greatly increased.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text:
Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash
reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually
drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Quick-Grow Extract
effect: Choose 1 of your {G} Pokémon in play. Put a random {G} Pokémon from your deck that evolves from that Pokémon onto that Pokémon to evolve it. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

name: Ledyba
flavor_text:
These very cowardly Pokémon join together and
use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
flavor_text:
It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly
dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to
you, good things will happen to you.

name: Shuckle
flavor_text:
The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually
become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Roselia
flavor_text:
It uses the different poisons in each hand
separately when it attacks. The stronger its
aroma, the healthier it is.

name: Roserade
flavor_text:
The poison in its right hand is quick acting.
The poison in its left hand is slow acting.
Both are life threatening.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text:
It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom
once a year.

name: Cacturne
flavor_text:
It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night
when it hunts for prey exhausted from the
desert's heat.

name: Chespin
flavor_text:
Eating lots of berries makes the bark shell that
covers Chespin's head and body grow sturdier.

name: Quilladin
flavor_text:
It can send a trailer flying with a tackle. It's numb
to pain, so even violent collisions don't faze it.

name: Chesnaught
flavor_text:
Its gentle disposition would have it avoid
conflict, but it gives opponents a thrashing with
its thorned fists when the situation calls for it.

name: Scatterbug
flavor_text:
This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder
to repel enemies. It will eat different plants
depending on where it lives.

name: Spewpa
flavor_text:
Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams
where it pleases across the fields and mountains,
building up the energy it needs to evolve.

name: Vivillon
flavor_text:
This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers
bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

name: Buzzwole
flavor_text:
Buzzwole goes around showing off its
abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind
of Ultra Beast.

name: Gossifleur
flavor_text:
It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous
song. This delightful display has charmed many
into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavor_text:
The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be
spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar
regional specialty.

name: Alolan Marowak
flavor_text:
The cursed flames that light up the bone carried
by this Pokémon are said to cause both mental
and physical pain that will never fade.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text:
When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves
the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Litleo
flavor_text:
The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by
battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane
will grow.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text:
The females of a pride work together to bring
down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride
doesn't starve.

name: Oricorio
flavor_text:
This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up
blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Scorbunny
flavor_text:
Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet,
raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny's
footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Raboot
flavor_text:
While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves,
it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its
flames have heated up its forehead.

name: Cinderace
flavor_text:
Using a ball that it made out of flames,
Cinderace blinds its opponents and
keeps them at bay.

name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon
flavor_text:
In this form, it draws on the power of fire.
It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavor_text:
In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards
with its six tails and sprays them around to cool
itself off.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavor_text:
It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its
feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a
frozen floor.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavor_text:
Its amusing movements make it very popular.
It releases its psychic power from the pattern
on its belly.

name: Delibird
flavor_text:
It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes.
If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.

name: Mudkip
flavor_text:
When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed
rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its
small size.

name: Marshtomp
flavor_text:
It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers
poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents
that are bogged down and unable to move.

name: Swampert
flavor_text:
Swampert's arms are rock-hard. With one swing,
they can batter down Swampert's foes. This
Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

name: Vanillite
flavor_text:
Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an
icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees
Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
flavor_text:
It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148
degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it
spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text:
People believe this Pokémon formed when two
Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is
roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text:
Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its
opponents and then flash-freezes them where
they stand.

name: Amaura
flavor_text:
Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone
extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes
be found frozen in ice.

name: Aurorus
flavor_text:
When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate
freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Chewtle
flavor_text:
A popular game among children is to lift up sticks
that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose
Chewtle can hang on the longest.

name: Drednaw
flavor_text:
Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey
come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck
out and chomps down on them.

name: Cramorant
flavor_text:
Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda's frantic
thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

name: Arrokuda
flavor_text:
After it's eaten its fill, its movements become
extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant
swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
flavor_text:
It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging
forward at speeds of over 100 knots before
ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon
flavor_text:
In this form, it draws on the power of water.
It attacks unrelentingly with kicks and ivy strikes.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text:
When several of these Pokémon gather, their
electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Alolan Raichu
flavor_text:
This Pokémon rides on its tail while it uses
its psychic powers to levitate. It attacks with
star-shaped thunderbolts.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text:
Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It's said
that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together,
lightning will fall immediately after.

name: Plusle
flavor_text:
This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone
poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its
body to create noises.

name: Minun
flavor_text:
Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under
the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms
made of sparks for cheering.

name: Toxel
flavor_text:
This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores
poison and electricity in two different sacs inside
its body.

name: Tadbulb
flavor_text:
It floats using the electricity stored in its body.
When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will
float higher off the ground.

name: Bellibolt
flavor_text:
What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs
for discharging the electricity generated by
Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.

name: Galarian Ponyta
flavor_text:
This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read
the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there,
it promptly hides away.

name: Galarian Rapidash
flavor_text:
Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily
through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic
power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text:
To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly
in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text:
Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This
laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

name: Granbull
flavor_text:
It can make most any Pokémon run away
by opening its big mouth to reveal its
thick fangs.

name: Ralts
flavor_text:
It is highly attuned to the emotions of people
and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
evolves_to: Gallade|Gallade ex|Gardevoir|Mega Gallade ex|Mega Gardevoir ex
flavor_text:
The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy
for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances
when happy.

name: Gardevoir
flavor_text:
It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power
when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely
with.

name: Litwick
flavor_text:
While shining a light and pretending to be a
guide, it leeches off the life-force of any who
follow it.

name: Lampent
flavor_text:
The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs
around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text:
It absorbs spirits, which it then burns. By waving
the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a
hypnotic trance.

name: Meloetta
flavor_text:
Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization
method that can control the feelings of those who
hear it.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavor_text:
The light that streams out from the holes in the
pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people
and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
flavor_text:
In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist
will come knocking. Whoever answers the door
will be swept off to the afterlife.

name: Sinistea
flavor_text:
Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it,
and then it steals your vitality from within. It also
tastes awful.

name: Polteageist
flavor_text:
These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots
and pouring themselves into leftover tea.

name: Indeedee
flavor_text:
This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer's side.
It predicts their actions with its psychic power
and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text:
No matter how high a place it falls from, this
Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball
and bouncing.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text:
The spikes on its body are made up of its
hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes
with its spikes.

name: Machop
flavor_text:
Always brimming with power, it passes time by
lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

name: Machoke
flavor_text:
Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps
people by doing work such as the moving of
heavy goods.

name: Machamp
flavor_text:
With four arms that react more quickly than it
can think, it can execute many punches at once.

name: Cubone
flavor_text:
This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased
mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry,
but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Meditite
flavor_text:
It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to
float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

name: Medicham
flavor_text:
It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like
steps, then launches a devastating blow in
the same motion.

name: Roggenrola
flavor_text:
When it detects a noise, it starts to move.
The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon
slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavor_text:
It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its
vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever
changing the direction it's facing.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text:
It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting
both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Tyrunt
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered.
It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer
just by playing around.

name: Tyrantrum
flavor_text:
A single bite of Tyrantrum's massive jaws will
demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the
ancient world.

name: Passimian
flavor_text:
The boss chooses 10 members of the group to
go out hunting. The hunting party will evenly split
the food they find with the rest of the group.

name: Falinks
flavor_text:
The leader, known as the brass, uses its
extendible horn to issue orders to the others
when it's time to change formation.

name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon
flavor_text:
In this form, it draws on the power of stone.
Its body is rock-solid, protecting it from all
manner of attacks.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavor_text:
Deeply proud and keenly smart, this Pokémon
moves with cunning during battle and relentlessly
attacks enemies' weak points.

name: Alolan Persian
flavor_text:
This Pokémon is one tough opponent. Not only
does it have formidable physical abilities, but it's
also not above fighting dirty.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavor_text:
Alolan Grimer will gladly gobble up any kind
of trash, making it a widely used and popular
Pokémon at garbage disposal facilities.

name: Alolan Muk
flavor_text:
What look like fangs and claws are actually
crystallized poison that will afflict you at a
mere touch, so don't get too close.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavor_text:
Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon,
it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon
its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavor_text:
This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly
challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavor_text:
It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.
While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that
would make any opponent flinch.

name: Stunky
flavor_text:
The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it
can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a
quarter away.

name: Skuntank
flavor_text:
It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its
tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text:
It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been
bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from
doing any mischief.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text:
Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable
behavior come away with stinging scratches from
its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavor_text:
Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant
figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text:
It will abruptly headbutt anyone that makes eye
contact with it. Its skull is extremely hard.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text:
This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very
good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text:
When its life comes to an end, it absorbs
the life energy of every living thing
and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Guzzlord
flavor_text:
An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be
constantly hungry—it is certainly always
devouring something.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavor_text:
These daring Pokémon have coins on their
foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder
coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavor_text:
After many battles, it evolved dangerous
claws that come together to form daggers
when extended.

name: Mawile
flavor_text:
It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are
actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text:
Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong
enough to bore through iron plates. This
Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text:
Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings.
Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's
spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text:
Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon
crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes
on its feelers into the stone.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavor_text:
Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in
the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps
its jagged steel fins down on them.

name: Honedge
flavor_text:
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the
true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it
drains people's lives away.

name: Doublade
flavor_text:
The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly
alternating between offense and defense to
bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text:
Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate
others. It once used its powers to force people
and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Bagon
flavor_text:
Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is
apparently the influence of information carried
in its genes.

name: Shelgon
flavor_text:
Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off.
The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy
and somewhat sluggish.

name: Salamence
flavor_text:
It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged.
It destroys everything with shredding claws
and fire.

name: Meowth
flavor_text:
It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny
object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Persian
flavor_text:
It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises
its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about
to pounce and bite.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text:
There are records of a lost human child being
raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

name: Sentret
flavor_text:
If it encounters a foe, it will stand up on its tail,
making itself look bigger than usual to intimidate
them.

name: Furret
flavor_text:
It is nimble and has a very flexible body.
Even if you get ahold of it, it'll slip right out
of your arms.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text:
The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from
the tip of the tail is predetermined for each
Smeargle.

name: Lugia
flavor_text:
It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is
rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Taillow
flavor_text:
It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other
lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles
a day.

name: Swellow
flavor_text:
It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its
prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text:
The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who
watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text:
It is always hungry because it won't stop
rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can't
keep still.

name: Slaking
flavor_text:
This Pokémon lives lying on its side. It only
rolls over and moves when there is no more
grass to eat.

name: Spinda
flavor_text:
Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its
stumbling movements, it evades opponents'
attacks brilliantly!

name: Tornadus
flavor_text:
Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail,
causing severe storms. Its power is great enough
to blow houses away.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text:
It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of
Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby
digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text:
The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally
well. People used to make heavy winter clothing
from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Tandemaus
flavor_text:
The pair sticks together no matter what. They
split any food they find exactly in half and then
eat it together.

name: Maushold
flavor_text:
The larger pair protects the little ones during
battles. When facing strong opponents, the
whole group will join the fight.

once a year.

name: Roserade
flavor_text:

bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

name: Buzzwole
flavor_text:

abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind
of Ultra Beast.
